programme.desc: Rudyard and Tess no longer want to talk to each other because they both have a different vision about the school party. Rudyard wants a Christmas party and Tess a Haloween party. What starts when a small fight escalates into a large conflict in which all students are involved. The school is divided into two camps: Kerstenhangers versus Haloweenaanhangers. The once two best friends are fighting a bite battle. / Rudyard en Tess willen niet meer met elkaar praten omdat ze allebei een andere visie hebben over het schoolfeest. programme.title: Taking care of Mama / Zorgen voor mama
programme.desc: Kristel visits with Deborah in the well -known social residential area "De Braemblokken" on t Kiel in Antwerp. An lives there, with her partner Tommy and their composite family: daughters Ashley and Jamy, and Nakomertje Ruby Ylva. Their apartment shows defects, Tommy is in collective debt scheme for 50 000 euros and receives no information from his mediator, and An has no grip on her household, children and finances. Fatih goes with Amber to the OCMW of Oudenburg. In Bruges, her application for living wage and shelter was refused after social research. But because she is currently sofas sleeping with a friend in Oudenburg, her file can hopefully be admitted there. Kristel learns big news from Wendy. Her teenage daughter Davina, 17 and included in a closed institution, is expecting unplanned. Because Davina is under juvenile judge, Wendy is very worried about her daughter and future grandchild. / Kristel gaat met Deborah langs in de bekende sociale woonwijk "De Braemblokken" op t Kiel in Antwerpen. Daar woont An, met haar partner Tommy en hun samengesteld gezin: dochters Ashley en Jamy, en nakomertje Ruby Ylva. Hun appartement vertoont gebreken, Tommy zit voor 50. 000 euro in collectieve schuldenregeling en krijgt geen info van zijn bemiddelaar, en An heeft geen grip meer op haar huishouden, kinderen en financiën. Fatih gaat met Amber naar het OCMW van Oudenburg. In Brugge werd haar aanvraag voor leefloon en onderdak geweigerd na sociaal onderzoek. Maar omdat ze momenteel sofaslaapt bij een vriendin in Oudenburg, kan haar dossier daar hopelijk wel worden opgenomen. Kristel verneemt groot nieuws van Wendy. Haar tienerdochter Davina, 17 en opgenomen in een gesloten instelling, is ongepland in verwachting. Omdat Davina onder jeugdrechter staat, maakt Wendy zich grote zorgen om haar dochter en toekomstig kleinkindje.

programme.title: Flanders Holiday Country / Vlaanderen vakantieland
programme.desc: Maureen Vanherberghen and radio maker Sofie Lemaire go on weekends in the Maasland. Maureen and Sofie sail from Limburg SailCenter in Ophoven-Kessenich de Maas on a Treibgut-Vlot. Along the way they moor to visit the white town of Thorn, just across the border with the Netherlands. There they are met by Stadsgids Annelies Frenken, who takes them on the theme walk The Mighty Women of Thorn. In the evening, Maureen and Sofie throw out their anchor in a quiet spot on the Maasplassen, for a snack and a drink and an invigorating night's sleep. The second day are Maureen and Sofie in Maaseik, where Stadsgids Lieve Weerjens introduces them to the story of the Bokkenrijders, who were very active in the region in the eighteenth century. Then a trip waits in a Fiat 500 that takes them to places that were important for the goat riders. / Maureen Vanherberghen en radiomaker Sofie Lemaire gaan op weekend in het Maasland. Maureen en Sofie varen vanuit Limburg Sailcenter in Ophoven-Kessenich de Maas af op een Treibgut-vlot. Onderweg meren ze aan om een bezoek te brengen aan het witte stadje Thorn, net over de grens met Nederland. Daar worden ze opgewacht door stadsgids Annelies Frenken, die hen meeneemt op de themawandeling De machtige vrouwen van Thorn. s Avonds gooien Maureen en Sofie hun anker uit op een rustig plekje op de Maasplassen, voor een hapje en een drankje en een verkwikkende nachtrust. De tweede dag zijn Maureen en Sofie in Maaseik, waar stadsgids Lieve Weetjens hen introduceert in het verhaal van de bokkenrijders, die in de achttiende eeuw heel actief waren in de streek. Daarna wacht hen een tochtje in een Fiat 500 die hen langs plekken brengt die belangrijk waren voor de bokkenrijders.

programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. programme.title: Tri mace / Tri mace
programme.desc: Animated series for the youngest about adventures of three fearless kittens who are always ready for new challenges. The cheerful kitten biscuit lives with his big brother Chok and little sister Lola. Their days are filled with fun and socializing with best friends. Vole se igrati, jesti slatkiše, te istraživati nepoznate pojave i predmete koji ih okružuju. Svaki dan upuštaju se u novu pustolovinu, a zahvaljujući mudrim savjetima njihovih brižnih roditelja, rješavaju sve prepreke i uče brojne životne lekcije.

programme.title: I'm Jackie Onassis / Ja sam Jackie Onassis
programme.desc: Studying the character of a woman who lived a tragedy before the public's eyes and began again, a documentary explores the legacy that goes beyond her role as the president's wife and widow, and presents her as one of the most important cultural icons in American history. Entering the Consciousness of Americans as a glamorous first lady who brought youth, culture and elegance into the White House, Jacqueline Bouvier Kennedy Onassis became the obsession of the media after assassination of her husband and the embodiment of the sorrow of America. Escaping into the privacy of Onassis's property in Greece, she eventually returned to New York and became a literary editor, and established control of her own life, finally leaving the shadow of the powerful. Cast: Carl Sferrazzza Anthony, Christopher Andersen, James Hart, Jeremy Scott Directed: Tanya Maryniak, Anna Wallner / Proučavajući karakter žene koja je pred očima javnosti proživjela tragediju i počela iznova, dokumentarni film istražuje naslijeđe koje nadilazi njenu ulogu predsjednikove supruge i udovice, te je predstavlja kao jednu od najvažnijih kulturnih ikona u američkoj historiji. Ušavši u svijest Amerikanaca kao glamurozna prva dama koja je u Bijelu kuću unijela mladost, kulturu i eleganciju, Jacqueline Bouvier Kennedy Onassis postala je opsesija medija nakon atentata na supruga i utjelovljenje žalosti Amerike. Pobjegavši u privatnost Onassisova posjeda u Grčkoj, naposljetku se vratila u New York i postala književna urednica, te je uspostavila kontrolu nad vlastitim životom, konačno izašavši iz sjene moćnika. Uloge: Carl Sferrazza Anthony, Christopher Andersen, James Hart, Jeremy Scott Režija: Tanya Maryniak, Anna Wallner

programme.desc: The mysteries of Dr. Blake (The Doctor: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) is an Australian television series first aired on ABC on February 1, 2013 at 8:30 pm [1]. Creg Dugal McLlan is in the role of Dr. Lucien Blake, who returned to Balarat, northwest of Melbourne, in the late 1950s, to take over the general medical practice of his late father and the role of a police surgeon after 30 years. Five seasons have been broadcast until 2017, after which the program is closed at the end of the fifth season. The first two seasons have 10 episodes while the next ones have 8 each. Each episode is about an hour - between 56 and 59 minutes. / Мистериите на доктор Блейк (на английски: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) е австралийски телевизионен сериал, излъчен за първи път по ABC на 1 февруари 2013 г. в 20:30 часа[1]. Крег Дугъл Маклалън е в ролята на доктор Лусиен Блейк, който се завръща в Баларат, северозападно от Мелбърн, в края на 1950-те години, за да поеме общата медицинска практика на покойния си баща и ролята на полицейски хирург след отсъствие от 30 години. Пет сезона се излъчват до 2017 г., след което програмата е закрита в края на петия сезон. Първите два сезона имат 10 епизода докато следващите имат по 8. Всеки епизод е около час – между 56 и 59 минути.

programme.title: Cultural heritage / Kulturna baština
programme.desc: Cultural Heritage - (Doc. Series, Croatia, 2008) several kilometers east of Sibenik are located fields, spaces that have their history and monuments, and at the same time are a series of links, of which those emotional are certainly not in the last place, connected to it. These are the premises that have retained their almost unrealistically beech atmosphere and even the archaic spirit despite civilizational teaks and the new age. R.: Luka Marotti ... / Kulturna baština - (dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2008) Nekoliko kilometara istočno od Šibenika smjestila su se polja, prostori koji imaju svoju povijest i spomenike, a istodobno su nizom poveznica, od kojih one emotivne posve sigurno nisu na posljednjem mjestu, s njime spojena. To su prostori koji su zadržali svoje gotovo nestvarno bukoličko ozračje pa i arhaični duh unatoč civilizacijskim tekovinama i novom dobu. R.: Luka Marotti...

programme.title: Gardener / Vrtlarica
programme.desc: Gardener - (S04, E10, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2023) For all those who feel nature as part of their lives, for those who enjoy the beauty of green plants and flowers, for those who have introduced gardening into their everyday life, there is a showcase. Starting from the position of nature protection and its own health, the author of Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, in addition to the already well -known stories of organic growing vegetables, fruits and flowers, also explores new areas related to horticulture and the green plant world. It reveals breeders that are plants and passion and life, beautifully shaped gardens, but also ways in which plants we can prepare, process and use in everyday life. The base and origin of these studies is the author's garden located on the Zagorje side of the hillside of Medvednica. He is a place of permanent experts with plants, but also a meeting place with interesting guests who transmit their own experiences about breeding or using plants. However, the author goes on, traveling around Croatia and meets interesting places and people who have tied their lives to the cultivation of some unusual species. For all those who want to really relax and enjoy the content that will provide inspiration and many useful ideas, Sunday afternoon will be reserved for the gardener from now on. R.: Nino Šoštarić ... / Vrtlarica - (S04, E10, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Za sve one koji prirodu osjećaju kao dio svog života, za one koji uživaju u ljepoti zelenih biljaka i cvijeća, za one koji su vrtlarstvo uveli u svoju svakodnevicu, tu je emisija Vrtlarica. Polazeći s pozicije zaštite prirode i vlastitog zdravlja, autorica Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, uz već poznate priče o organskom uzgoju povrća, voća i cvijeća, istražuje i nova područja vezana uz hortikulturu i zeleni biljni svijet. Otkriva uzgajivače kojima su biljke i strast i život, predivno oblikovane vrtove, ali i načine na koje biljke možemo pripremiti, preraditi i koristiti u svakodnevnom životu. Baza i ishodište tih istraživanja je autoričin vrt smješten na zagorskoj strani obronaka Medvednice. On je mjesto stalnih eksperimanata s biljakama, ali i mjesto susreta sa zanimljivim gostima koji prenose vlastita iskustva o uzgoju ili korištenju biljaka. No, autorica polazi i dalje, putuje po Hrvatskoj i upoznaje zanimljiva mjesta i ljude koji su svoj život vezali uz uzgoj neke neobične vrste. Za sve one koji se žele doista opustiti i uživati u sadržaju koji će pružiti inspiraciju i mnoštvo korisnih ideja, nedjelja poslijepodne bit će od sada rezervirana za Vrtlaricu. R.: Nino Šoštarić...

programme.title: David Skoko: Eat on the road / David Skoko: Jesti na cesti
programme.desc: David Skoko: Eat on the road - (E05, Education Program, Croatia, 2025) Chef David Skoko takes us to an exciting gastronomic journey with its companion, a red retro cooking. The dynamics of the modern life is fast, which means we don't always have the opportunity for long meals, so we will sometimes eat on the road. Street food or Street Food has become part of the vital culinary scene. But we often identify it with US or Asian cuisine. Can we also inspire street food? David travels by its beautiful and visits their friends, also some of our most important and most creative chefs, so together forces, with a lot of fun, tearing out the possibilities of local foods and seek recipes for our homemade street food. R.: Radislav Jovanov Gonzo ... / David Skoko: Jesti na cesti - (E05, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) Chef David Skoko vodi nas na uzbudljivo gastronomsko putovanje sa svojim suputnikom, crvenim retro kombijem za kuhanje. Dinamika suvremenoga života je brza, što znači da nemamo uvijek mogućnost za duge obroke pa ćemo ponekad i jesti na cesti. Ulična hrana ili street food postala je dio vitalne kulinarske scene. No često je poistovjećujemo samo s američkom ili azijskom kuhinjom. Možemo li se i mi inspirirati uličnom hranom? David putuje Lijepom Našom i posjećuje svoje prijatelje, ujedno neke od naših najvažnijih i najkreativnijih chefova, pa zajednički snagama, uz puno zabave, otkivaju mogućnosti lokalnih namirnica i traže recepte za našu domaću uličnu hranu. R.: Radislav Jovanov Gonzo...

Također kaže da se barun do Rio Vermelho vratio i želi se oženiti njome. Salomao sazna od Marca da Cony želi dokaz da će Simone otputovati u Brazil. Tiradentes i Tomane pokušavaju se naučiti lijepim manirima za vjenčanje. Tiago i Sal provedu noć zajedno. Simone otkrije Ruiju da ju je barun zaprosio. programme.desc: Golden League - (Educational Program, Croatia, 2025) What binds Professor Emeritus who ended his career as a Vice -Rector at Liverpolo University and radio and television author, presenter and editor? R.: Mladen Simunov ... / Zlatna liga - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) Što veže profesora emeritusa koji je karijeru završio kao prorektor na liverpulskom sveučilištu i radijskog i televizijskog autora, voditelja i urednika? He travels to a visit to the close friend Igor Gudcu, a chef who says it is first a caterer, because she first finds guests, and only then the chef. programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E20, featured series, Spain) in 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of La Provece owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conde Ul .... / La promesa - (S04, E20, igrana serija, Španjolska) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Conde Ul....

programme.title: Sisi / Sisi
programme.desc: SISI - (S04, E04, feature series, Germany, 2024) The new fourth season of Sisi series brings: After the crash on the riding and the death of her father, Max Sisi returns to Bavaria. He reveals that Max lost Posenhofen Castle in a bet with Jockey Georg Basslet von La Rosee at a horse race. In order to save the family castle, Sisi asks for a rematch from George, who accepts the challenge, but only on condition that the Empress is competing in the race. In order to train with the yoguna horse Avalon, Sisi must break the promise given to Francis that she will no longer ride and gain the mysterious groom Linda to help her make contact with the horse. During the preparations for the Sisi race, she learns that Max has led a double life and that Linda is her half -sister. When her father's former mistress, Linda's mother Adele, finds dead, he sucks that she lurks significantly darker secrets under the surface of her once seemingly perfect family. Faced with new responsibilities, Sisa's older brother Louis must choose between the promising career of the Minister of Justice and the Love of Citizens, opera singer Henriette Mendel. During this time, Sisa's mother Ludovika desperately seeks to find a suitable role for her youngest daughter, the rebellious Sophie Charlotte. But she fell in love with, no less or no more, the fairytale King Ludviga II. R .: Sven Bohse Ul.: Dominique devenport, Janik Schumann, David Korbmann, Desiree Nosbusch, Antonia Moretti ... / Sisi - (S04, E04, igrana serija, Njemačka, 2024) Nova četvrta sezona serije Sisi donosi: Nakon nesreće na jahanju i smrti njezina oca Maxa Sisi se vraća u Bavarsku. Otkriva da je Max izgubio dvorac Possenhofen u okladi s džokejem Georgom Basseletom von La Roseeom na konjskoj utrci. Kako bi spasila obiteljski dvorac, Sisi zatraži revanš od Georga koji prihvaća izazov, ali samo pod uvjetom da se u utrci natječe sama carica. Radi treniranja s jogunastim konjem Avalonom Sisi mora prekršiti obećanje dano Franji da više neće jahati te pridobiva tajanstvenu konjušaricu Lindu da joj pomogne uspostaviti kontakt s konjem. Tijekom priprema za utrku Sisi doznaje da je Max vodio dvostruki život i da je Linda njezina polusestra. Kad očevu bivšu ljubavnicu, Lindinu majku Adele, pronađu mrtvu, Sisi posumnja da znatno mračnije tajne vrebaju ispod površine njezine nekoć naizgled savršene obitelji. Suočen s novim odgovornostima, Sisin stariji brat Louis mora izabrati između perspektivne karijere ministra pravosuđa i ljubavi prema građanki, opernoj pjevačici Henriette Mendel. Za to vrijeme Sisina majka Ludovika očajnički nastoji pronaći prikladnu ulogu za svoju najmlađu kćer, buntovnu Sophie Charlotte. No, ona se smrtno zaljubila u, ni manje ni više, bajkovitoga kralja Ludviga II. R.: Sven Bohse Ul.: Dominique Devenport, Jannik Schumann, David Korbmann, Desiree Nosbusch, Antonia Moretti...

programme.title: Truth and lies / Istina i laži
programme.desc: Truth and Lies - (E06, Educational Program, England, 2022) Some people have crucially influenced the course of history. They create and shape public opinion and skillfully use the technological achievements of their time to spread their views. No area of ​​society is safe from their influence. In doing so, they do not despise suspicious methods, they use lies and twist the truth to their advantage. Tom Ockers studies this phenomenon more closely, starting with the apostle Paul to today's algorithms ... / Truth and Lies - (E06, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2022) Neki su ljudi presudno utjecali na tijek povijesti. Oni stvaraju i oblikuju javno mišljenje i vješto rabe tehnološka dostignuća svojeg vremena za širenje svojih stavova. Nijedno područje društva nije sigurno od njihova utjecaja. Pritom ne prezaju od sumnjivih metoda, služe se lažima i izvrću istinu u svoju korist. Tom Ockers pobliže proučava ovaj fenomen, počevši od apostola Pavla pa sve do današnjih algoritama...

He reveals that Max lost Posenhofen Castle in a bet with Jockey Georg Basslet von La Rosee at a horse race. In order to save the family castle, Sisi asks for a rematch from George, who accepts the challenge, but only on condition that the Empress is competing in the race. In order to train with the yoguna horse Avalon, Sisi must break the promise given to Francis that she will no longer ride and gain the mysterious groom Linda to help her make contact with the horse. During the preparations for the Sisi race, she learns that Max has led a double life and that Linda is her half -sister. When her father's former mistress, Linda's mother Adele, finds dead, he sucks that she lurks significantly darker secrets under the surface of her once seemingly perfect family. Faced with new responsibilities, Sisa's older brother Louis must choose between the promising career of the Minister of Justice and the Love of Citizens, opera singer Henriette Mendel. During this time, Sisa's mother Ludovika desperately seeks to find a suitable role for her youngest daughter, the rebellious Sophie Charlotte. But she fell in love with, no less or no more, the fairytale King Ludviga II. R .: Sven Bohse Ul.: Dominique devenport, Janik Schumann, David Korbmann, Desiree Nosbusch, Antonia Moretti ... / Sisi - (S04, E04, igrana serija, Njemačka, 2024) Nova četvrta sezona serije Sisi donosi: Nakon nesreće na jahanju i smrti njezina oca Maxa Sisi se vraća u Bavarsku. Otkriva da je Max izgubio dvorac Possenhofen u okladi s džokejem Georgom Basseletom von La Roseeom na konjskoj utrci. Kako bi spasila obiteljski dvorac, Sisi zatraži revanš od Georga koji prihvaća izazov, ali samo pod uvjetom da se u utrci natječe sama carica. Radi treniranja s jogunastim konjem Avalonom Sisi mora prekršiti obećanje dano Franji da više neće jahati te pridobiva tajanstvenu konjušaricu Lindu da joj pomogne uspostaviti kontakt s konjem. Tijekom priprema za utrku Sisi doznaje da je Max vodio dvostruki život i da je Linda njezina polusestra. Kad očevu bivšu ljubavnicu, Lindinu majku Adele, pronađu mrtvu, Sisi posumnja da znatno mračnije tajne vrebaju ispod površine njezine nekoć naizgled savršene obitelji. Suočen s novim odgovornostima, Sisin stariji brat Louis mora izabrati između perspektivne karijere ministra pravosuđa i ljubavi prema građanki, opernoj pjevačici Henriette Mendel. Za to vrijeme Sisina majka Ludovika očajnički nastoji pronaći prikladnu ulogu za svoju najmlađu kćer, buntovnu Sophie Charlotte. No, ona se smrtno zaljubila u, ni manje ni više, bajkovitoga kralja Ludviga II. R.: Sven Bohse Ul.: Dominique Devenport, Jannik Schumann, David Korbmann, Desiree Nosbusch, Antonia Moretti...

programme.title: Cultural heritage / Kulturna baština
programme.desc: Cultural Heritage - (Doc. Series, Croatia, 2013) in medieval cities with surrounded walls where the space was valuable and carefully planned, there were usually no parks or larger green spaces. Only when the ramparts and towers became superfluous and when the circumstances allowed it could they begin to conquer new areas outside the historic center. Thus, at the end of the 19th century, the Sibenik "Djardin" was created, a park that today bears the name of Robert Visiani, a botanist born here in 1800. If the beauty is the promise of happiness, the people of Sibenik really could be happy in their little oasis of greenery arranged by Italian public parks. R.: Luka Marotti ... / Kulturna baština - (dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2013) U srednjovjekovnim gradovima opasanim zidinama gdje je prostor bio dragocjen i pomno isplaniran obično nije bilo perivoja ni većih zelenih površina. Tek kada su bedemi i kule postali suvišni i kada su okolnosti to dopustile, mogle su se početi osvajati nove površine izvan povijesne jezgre. Tako je potkraj 19. stoljeća nastao i šibenski "đardin", perivoj koji danas nosi ime Roberta Visianija, botaničara rođenog ovdje 1800. godine. Ako je ljepota obećanje sreće, Šibenčani su doista mogli biti sretni u svojoj maloj oazi zelenila uređenoj po uzoru na talijanske javne parkove. R.: Luka Marotti...

programme.title: Gardener / Vrtlarica
programme.desc: Gardener - (S04, E11, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2023) For all those who feel nature as part of their lives, for those who enjoy the beauty of green plants and flowers, for those who have introduced gardening into their everyday life, there is a showcase. Starting from the position of nature protection and its own health, the author of Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, in addition to the already well -known stories of organic growing vegetables, fruits and flowers, also explores new areas related to horticulture and the green plant world. It reveals breeders that are plants and passion and life, beautifully shaped gardens, but also ways in which plants we can prepare, process and use in everyday life. The base and origin of these studies is the author's garden located on the Zagorje side of the hillside of Medvednica. He is a place of permanent experts with plants, but also a meeting place with interesting guests who transmit their own experiences about breeding or using plants. However, the author goes on, traveling around Croatia and meets interesting places and people who have tied their lives to the cultivation of some unusual species. For all those who want to really relax and enjoy the content that will provide inspiration and many useful ideas, Sunday afternoon will be reserved for the gardener from now on. R.: Nino Šoštarić ... / Vrtlarica - (S04, E11, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Za sve one koji prirodu osjećaju kao dio svog života, za one koji uživaju u ljepoti zelenih biljaka i cvijeća, za one koji su vrtlarstvo uveli u svoju svakodnevicu, tu je emisija Vrtlarica. Polazeći s pozicije zaštite prirode i vlastitog zdravlja, autorica Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, uz već poznate priče o organskom uzgoju povrća, voća i cvijeća, istražuje i nova područja vezana uz hortikulturu i zeleni biljni svijet. Otkriva uzgajivače kojima su biljke i strast i život, predivno oblikovane vrtove, ali i načine na koje biljke možemo pripremiti, preraditi i koristiti u svakodnevnom životu. Baza i ishodište tih istraživanja je autoričin vrt smješten na zagorskoj strani obronaka Medvednice. On je mjesto stalnih eksperimanata s biljakama, ali i mjesto susreta sa zanimljivim gostima koji prenose vlastita iskustva o uzgoju ili korištenju biljaka. No, autorica polazi i dalje, putuje po Hrvatskoj i upoznaje zanimljiva mjesta i ljude koji su svoj život vezali uz uzgoj neke neobične vrste. Za sve one koji se žele doista opustiti i uživati u sadržaju koji će pružiti inspiraciju i mnoštvo korisnih ideja, nedjelja poslijepodne bit će od sada rezervirana za Vrtlaricu. R.: Nino Šoštarić...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E21, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Provece owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E21, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: The water world of the dresser / Vodeni svijet Komoda
programme.desc: The Waterworld of Komodo - (E04, Nature. Film, Poland, 2021) This documentary series takes us on an extraordinary trip to one of the most beautiful places on Earth. During the millions of years, the archipelago around the Island of Komoda was formed by the forces of nature and the mechanisms of evolution. Thanks to its isolation, today we can admire the works of nature that do not exist anywhere else on the planet. On land are undisputed rulers of legendary dragons, while under the water of a strong current flows around coral reefs that abound in life. The underwater world is ruled by sharks and magnificent mants. Each of the five episodes shows both worlds as well as the laws that governed them. The series allows us to get to know the unique ecosystem and discover the region whose world was periodically destroyed by devastating volcanoes. The series is also an exceptional journey that rethinks the role of man on earth. Each episode has a major topic. Commodern Varani, manta or sharks are shown in their natural environment. However, the authors are not only focused on the hero of the episodes, but also of the conditions in which he lives and other inhabitants in his ecosystem. The series also depicts people living in its ecosystem as well as the mutual influence of man and nature. R .: Andrzej MisiUk ... / The Waterworld of Komodo - (E04, prirod. film, Poljska, 2021) Ova dokumentarna serija vodi nas na iznimno putovanje na jedno od najljepših mjesta na Zemlji. Tijekom milijuna godina arhipelag oko otoka Komoda oblikovale su sile prirode i mehanizmi evolucije. Zahvaljujući njegovoj izoliranosti, i danas se možemo diviti djelima prirode kakva ne postoje nigdje drugdje na planetu. Na kopnu su neprikosnoveni vladari legendarni zmajevi, dok ispod vode snažne struje teku oko koraljnih grebena koji obiluju životom. Podvodnim svijetom vladaju morski psi i veličanstvene mante. Svaka od pet epizoda prikazuje oba svijeta kao i zakone koji njima upravljaju. Serija nam omogućuje da upoznamo jedinstveni ekosustav i otkrijemo regiju čiji su svijet periodički uništavali razorni vulkani. Serija je i iznimno putovanje koje preispituje ulogu čovjeka na Zemlji. Svaka epizoda ima glavnu temu. Komodski varani, mante ili morski psi prikazani su u svom prirodnom okružju. Ipak, autori se ne usredotočuju samo na junaka epizode, nego i na uvjete u kojima živi te na druge stanovnike u njegovu ekosustavu. Serija prikazuje i ljude koji žive u njegovu ekosustavu kao i međusobni utjecaj čovjeka i prirode. R.: Andrzej Misiuk...

Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.desc: Great stories, little people - (E06, Educational Program, Croatia, 2025) Tajana is a life like a movie story. And not any, but he told in the movie Coda, award -winning Oscars. Tajana is the only audible person in her family. He works as a translator at the Zagreb Association of deaf -blinds and without it the users of the association do not function. They do not see or hear, but they create amazing works of art. Tajana prepares an exhibition of users of the Association. We get acquainted with Kiki, painter, and the heat brothers, sculptors, who, although they do not see or hear, prepare their incredible works for the upcoming exhibition. A layered story of a meaningful life, a handicap, creativity and incredible talents. R.: Nancy Profaca ... / Velike priče, mali ljudi - (E06, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) Tajanin je život poput filmske priče. Tajana priprema izložbu korisnika Udruge. Upoznajemo se s Kikijem, slikarom, i braćom Vrućina, kiparima, koji iako ne vide i ne čuju, spremaju svoje nevjerojatne radove za nadolazeću izložbu. programme.title: The paths of Frankopan / Putovima Frankopana
programme.desc: Frankopan Roads - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2025) The Frankopan family from the 12th to 17th centuries had a great influence on the political, economic and cultural life of Croatia. Reconstruction, preservation, protection and sustainable use of Frankopan material and intangible heritage are the goals of the project cultural and tourist route to Frankopan, which has launched the Primorje-Gorski Kotar County in 2017. What is the challenges of the renovation of the facilities that have lost its purpose because the world in which they have arisen has completely changed? programme.desc: Gatori - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2024) Gators have been digging in Baranja for centuries. programme.title: Sokol's eyes / Oči sokolove
programme.desc: Falcon's eyes - (E08, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2024) The ancient Romans called him an imperial island, and legend says he was visited by the Mediterranean on his travels. Lastovo. This mysterious islands of incomprehensible beauty and the most beautiful sky in this part of Europe is a hidden pearl of the Adriatic Sea. Our trip to this mysterious archipelago begins on the islet of Glavat. The shots from the air meet the Croatian remote swimmer Dina Levacic, who swim around Glavat and the remaining 103 Croatian islands, islets and cliffs wants to raise the environmental awareness of citizens about the importance of maintaining the Adriatic Sea clean. The episode also brings stunning shots from the air of the Lastovo Islands Nature Park. Alexandra Carol Horvat, the main guardian of the Lastovo Islands PP, will be introduced to the peculiarities of the flora and fauna of this southern pearl. In the heart of the settlement, the famous drone will also feature the famous Lastovo carnage. Many masks, dance, song and fireworks have marked this event so important in the life of each resident of this island. The fisherman Ante also testifies that life on the island can be cruel and demanding. We followed him during the morning fish in the village of Zaklopatica. In the south of the Lastovo archipelago, we also visited the beacon Mladen on the Lighthouse of Struga, and the episode also brings stunning beauty of the islands during the famous Lastovo Trail race. At the end of our trip, we return to the village of Lastovo where we will see the production of the traditional Lastovo fumara. One of his last builders will be discussed about the famous chimneys and their construction. R.: Filip Filkovic ... / Oči sokolove - (E08, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2024) Stari Rimljani su ga nazivali carskim otokom, a legenda kaže kako ga je na svojim putovanjima Sredozemljem posjetio čak i Odisej. Lastovo. To tajanstveno otočje neshvatljive ljepote i najljepšeg neba u ovom dijelu Europe skriveni je biser Jadranskog mora. Naše putovanje ovim misterioznim arhipelagom počinje na otočiću Glavat. Snimke iz zraka ondje susreću hrvatsku daljinsku plivačicu Dinu Levačić koja plivajući oko Glavata i još preostala 103 hrvatska otoka, otočića i hridi želi podići ekološku svijest građana o važnosti održavanja Jadranskog mora čistim. Epizoda donosi i zadivljujuće snimke iz zraka Parka prirode Lastovsko otočje. S posebnostima flore i faune ovog južnog bisera upoznat će nas Alexandra Carol Horvat, glavna čuvarica PP Lastovsko otočje. U srcu naselja zadivljujuće snimke dronom prikazat će i poznati lastovski poklad. Mnoštvo maski, ples, pjesma i vatromet obilježili su ovaj događaj toliko važan u životu svakog stanovnika ovog otoka. Da život na otoku često zna biti surov i zahtjevan, svjedoči nam i ribar Ante. Pratili smo ga prilikom jutarnjeg ulova ribe u mjestu Zaklopatica. Na samom jugu Lastovskog arhipelaga posjetili smo i svjetioničara Mladena na svjetioniku Struga, a epizoda donosi i zadivljujuće ljepote otočja tijekom održavanja poznate utrke Lastovo trail. Na kraju našeg putovanja vraćamo se u naselje Lastovo gdje ćemo vidjeti izradu tradicionalnog lastovskog fumara. O poznatim dimnjacima i njihovoj izgradi govorit će jedan od njegovih posljednjih graditelja. R.: Filip Filković...

programme.title: Half a century of disc / Pola stoljeća diska
programme.desc: Half a century Disk - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2015) Petar Ivulic, Split adventurer of Brac roots and Paris addresses, in 1964 in Jelsa on the island of Hvar, opened the first discoklub in the then country. It cannot register it under that name because such a thing does not exist as an option ... With this pioneering venture, a wave of opening of discoklubs across the country was launched and this form of social gathering was marked by the next two decades. But was Jelska's "Amphora" first? They have a different opinion at the Opatija Museum in Opatija. What makes one club a real discoklub? What was the importance of these places? Positive and negative effects on society? The movie answers these and many other questions. Filmed in Jelsa, Opatija, Rijeka, Split, Zagreb and Paris, with the help of about fifty interlocutors, illustrated with archival recordings, photographs and documents from that time and contemporary recordings of locations, revives the pioneering period of discor in Croatia. Husar, Amphora, Club 57, Arcada, Semafor, Saloon ... What did these names mean to us today? R.: Zvonimir Rumboldt Ul.: Ana Majhenic ... / Pola stoljeća diska - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2015) Petar Ivulić, splitski avanturist bračkih korijena a pariške adrese, godine 1964. u Jelsi na otoku Hvaru otvara prvi diskoklub u tadašnjoj državi. Ne može ga registrirati pod tim imenom jer takvo što ne postoji kao opcija... Tim pionirskim pothvatom pokrenut je val otvaranja diskoklubova diljem zemlje i taj oblik socijalnog druženja obilježio je sljedeće dvije dekade. No, je li baš jelšanska "Amfora" bila prva? U Muzeju turizma u Opatiji imaju drugačije mišljenje. Što to jedan klub čini pravim diskoklubom? Koja je bila važnost tih mjesta? Pozitivni i negativni učinci na društvo? Film odgovara na ta i mnoga druga pitanja. Sniman u Jelsi, Opatiji, Rijeci, Splitu, Zagrebu i Parizu, uz pomoć pedesetak sugovornika, ilustriran arhivskim snimkama, fotografijama i dokumentima iz tog vremena te suvremenim snimkama lokacija, oživljava pionirsko razdoblje diskogroznice u Hrvatskoj. Husar, Amfora, Club 57, Arkada, Semafor, Saloon... Što su ta imena značila onda i što nam govore danas? R.: Zvonimir Rumboldt Ul.: Ana Majhenić...

By visiting Varanas or Benares (as they call it), Mark Twain wrote: "Varanas is older than history, older than tradition, older than legend, and if you put it all together, Varanasi looks twice as old as." It is located along the Holy River Ganges that pilgrims come to swim. Life happens on the gates along the river. Prayers, burning the dead, rites and celebrations alternate on the gates along the river, forming a magnificent blend of mystical and earthly. R .: Ljubica Jankovic Lazaric ... / Moja Indija - (E05, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2003) Najsvetiji grad u Indiji, star 2000 godina, jedan je od najstarijih gradova na svijetu. Mark Twain je posjetivši Varanasi ili Benares (kako ga danas zovu) napisao: "Varanasi je stariji od povijesti, stariji od tradicije, stariji od legende, a ako sve to stavite zajedno, Varanasi izgleda još dva puta stariji." Smješten je uz svetu rijeku Ganges u koju se hodočasnici dolaze kupati. Život se događa na gatovima uz rijeku. Molitve, spaljivanje mrtvaca, obredi i slavlja izmjenjuju se na gatovima uz rijeku tvoreći veličanstven spoj mističnog i ovozemaljskog. R.: Ljubica Janković Lazarić...

programme.title: Wetlands and life in them / Močvarna staništa i život u njima
programme.desc: Wet habitats and life in them - (E02, Doc. Film, Croatia, 2010) Wetland habitats belong to the most productive ecosystems in the world, along with rain forests and coral reefs. Kopački rit is one of the most important floods in Europe. The value of the Kopački rit Nature Park was confirmed in 1993 by its inclusion on the list of wet areas of international importance, especially as the habitats of the swamp birds, according to the Ramsar Convention, ie the Convention on Wet Areas. R .: Dominik Zen ... / Močvarna staništa i život u njima - (E02, dok. film, Hrvatska, 2010) Močvarna staništa pripadaju najproduktivnijim ekosustavima na svijetu, zajedno s kišnim šumama i koraljnim grebenima. Kopački rit je jedno od najvažnijih poplavnih područja u Europi. Vrijednost Parka prirode Kopački rit potvrđena je 1993. godine njegovim uvrštavanjem na popis vlažnih područja od međunarodne važnosti, osobito kao staništa ptica močvarica, prema Ramsarskoj konvenciji, odnosno Konvenciji o vlažnim područjima. R.: Dominik Zen...

programme.title: Man of the puzzle / Čovjek slagalica
programme.desc: The Jigsaw Man - (Thriller, England, 1983) The former head of the British Secret Service Mi6 Philip Kimberly raised a lot of dust by changing the side, ie. Joined the USSR. Incenting his false death and burial, the Soviets decide Kimberly to give a new face and the identity of the Žuzmin (M. Caine), a commercial Ataše in the London Embassy. The Soviets promise Kimberly a million Swiss francs and a new identity in exchange for a long way out of the long-missed list of all payments to their agents in the west. As soon as he arrived at Kimberly Airport, Kimberly ran away, and by the old and new bosses. The pursuit of him is managed by the intelligence boss (L. Olivier), and Jamie Fraser (R. Powell), the current lover of the former Kimberly's wife Penelope (S. George) (S. George) (S. George) ... Kuzminsky), Laurence Olivier (Sir Gerald Scaith), Susan George, Robert Powell (Jamie Fraser), Charles Gray (Sir James Charley) ... / The Jigsaw Man - (triler, Engleska, 1983) Nekadašnji šef britanske tajne službe MI6 Philip Kimberly podigao je podosta prašine promijenivši stranu, tj. pridružio se SSSR-u. Inscenirajući njegovu lažnu smrt i pokop, Sovjeti odluče Kimberlyju podariti novo lice i identitet Sergeja Kuzminskog (M. Caine), komercijalnog atašea u londonskom veleposlanstvu. Sovjeti obećaju Kimberlyju milijun švicarskih franaka i nov identitet u zamjenu za davno nestali popis svih isplata njihovim agentima na Zapadu. Čim je stigao na londonski aerodrom Kimberly je pobjegao, i starim i novim gazdama. Potjerom za njime rukovodi obavještajni šef, admiral Gerald Scaith (L. Olivier), a u njoj sudjeluje i Jamie Fraser (R. Powell), sadašnji ljubavnik bivše Kimberlyjeve supruge Penelope (S. George)... R.: Terence Young Ul.: Michael Caine (Philip Kimberly/Sergei Kuzminsky), Laurence Olivier (Sir Gerald Scaith), Susan George (Annabelle Kimberley / Penelope Kimberley), Robert Powell (Jamie Fraser), Charles Gray (Sir James Charley)...

programme.title: Photos in Croatia / Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: Photo in Croatia - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2013) The black and white photographic cycle called the room is an intimate daily series that has been recorded by Mario Kučera since 2003. As a photographer of the weekly magazine, he travels to the world metropolises by task, but none of the glamor of travel to new spaces is present in these photos. He simply portrays himself, in the interiors of anonymous hotel rooms that always resemble one another. Mario Kučera, born in 1967 in Slavonski Brod, has been working as a newspaper photographer since 1996. In parallel to work, his author's cycles are formed ... / Fotografija u Hrvatskoj - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2013) Crno-bijeli fotografski ciklus pod nazivom Sobe intimni je dnevnički serijal koji Mario Kučera bilježi od 2003. godine. Kao fotograf tjednog magazina putuje svjetskim metropolama po zadatku, ali ništa od glamura putovanja novim prostorima nije prisutno na ovim fotografijama. On jednostavno portretira samog sebe, u interijerima anonimnih hotelskih soba koje uvijek nalikuju jedne na drugu. Mario Kučera, rođen 1967. u Slavonskom Brodu, radi kao novinski fotograf od 1996. godine. Usporedno s poslom nastaju i njegovi autorski ciklusi...

programme.title: Out of format / Izvan formata
programme.desc: Out of format - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2023) in May 2024. The competition for this award has recently been the project of the premises of the Association "My Place under the Sun" in Rijeka, the only one in the category of social integrative architecture with public purpose. The specific interaction of social engagement and art, and a space that in addition to function brings a new quality of life to its users are topics outside format. Guests are: Ida Križaj Leko, Architect, and Zoran Grozdanov, Theologian, Volunteer of the Cekade Association ... / Izvan formata - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2023) U svibnju 2024. dodjeljuje se najuglednija europska arhitektonska nagrada Mies van der Rohe. U konkurenciji za tu nagradu nedavno se našao i projekt prostora udruge "Moje mjesto pod Suncem" u Rijeci, jedini u kategoriji socijalno integrativne arhitekture s javnom namjenom. Specifična interakcija društvenog angažmana i umjetnosti te prostor koji osim funkcije donosi i novu kvalitetu života njegovim korisnicima tema su emisije Izvan formata. Gosti su: Ida Križaj Leko, arhitektica, i Zoran Grozdanov, teolog, volonter udruge CeKaDe...

programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2022) is our guest Lars Fr. H. Svendsen, a professor at the Institute of Philosophy of the University of Bergen. He has received several international awards and his books have been translated into 25 languages. His most famous books are "Philosophy of Boredom", "What is Philosophy?", "The Philosophy of Evil", "Fear" and "Philosophy of Loneliness" and the latest "Philosophy of Lies". After talking about freedom, evil and lies, it's time for mythology. And that of the city of Daruvar, into which film, television, theater and radio screenwriter, director and writer Dejan Sorak placed the shop of his new crime "Kupelj of God Silvan" ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2022) Naš je gost Lars Fr. H. Svendsen, profesor na Institutu za filozofiju Sveučilišta u Bergenu. Dobitnik je nekoliko međunarodnih nagrada, a knjige su mu prevedene na 25 jezika. Najpoznatije su mu knjige "Filozofija dosade", "Što je filozofija?", "Filozofija zla", "Strah" i "Filozofija usamljenosti" i najnovija "Filozofija laži". Nakon razgovora o slobodi, zlu i laži, vrijeme je za mitologiju. I to onu grada Daruvara u koji je filmski, televizijski, kazališni i radijski scenarist, redatelj i pisac Dejan Šorak smjestio radnju svog novog krimića "Kupelj boga Silvana"...

programme.title: The world of classics / Svijet klasike
programme.desc: Classic World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) This is the first broadcast of four of them, which is being covered by the multi -day program of the sixth edition of the Euphonie Festival in Warsaw, the Festival of Central European and Eastern European Music, which took place this year under the theme "Jeke and Srection". It brings a review of a magnificent concert performance of a summer opera star, the world's largest mezzo -soprano Elina Garanče, with the Orchestra of the Great Theater of the Polish National Opera and under the leadership of her life and professional partner Karel Marko Chichon. The "Opera Gala" concert in November 15 was held and, among other things, performed the rarity aria of Carmen, which Bizet originally wrote for his heroine, but the singers declared it impossible for her and replaced her with a famous Habaner. Although she is talked about in an interview with Garanca, we could not record her for banning her publisher. That is why, with the interviews, we housed her first performance of Julia's lullaby from the 3rd act of Dvořák's Opera "Jakobinac" op. 84 from 1888, with which she opened a spectacular concert, respecting the geographical framework of the festival. After the concert, the singer and conductor shared autographs in the foyer of the halls late into the night and took pictures with fans who were patiently waiting in an endless order. At the same time, it was an occasion for exclusively for Croatian television to announce their recent arrival in Zagreb on February 10, 2025, when they would perform in the "Best of Elina Garanca" program at the Lisinski Concert Hall, which they both look forward to because the previous two concerts in that hall, at the invitation of its former director Drazen Siriščević. Many of his participants in the auditorium are discussed about the Euphonie Festival and the Euphonie Festival: Olga Wysock, Director of the National Institute Adam Mickiewicz, in charge of promoting Polish art abroad; King Wojciechowska, owner and editor -in -chief of magazine and portal dedicated to music and art, Presto Publish, Mediac ... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Ovo je prva emisija u nizu od četiri, koliko ih obrađuje višednevni program šestog izdanja Festivala Eufonie u Varšavi, festivala srednjoeuropske i istočnoeuropske glazbe, koji se ove godine odvio pod temom "Jeke i odzvanjanja". Donosi osvrt na veličanstven koncertni nastup letonske operne zvijezde, najveće svjetske mezzosopranistice Eline Garanče, uz Orkestar Velikog kazališta Poljske narodne opere i pod vodstvom njezina životnog i profesionalnog partnera Karela Marka Chichona. "Opera gala" koncert u održan je 15. studenog i na njemu su, među ostalim, izveli raritetnu ariju Carmen koju je Bizet izvorno napisao za svoju junakinju, ali su je pjevačice njegova doba proglasile neizvedivom pa ju je zamijenio poznatom habanerom. Premda se o njoj govori u intervjuu s Garančom, nismo je mogli snimiti zbog zabrane njezina izdavača. Zato smo uz intervjue smjestili njezinu prvu izvedbu Julijine uspavanke iz 3. čina Dvořákove opere "Jakobinac" op. 84. iz 1888., s kojim je otvorila spektakularni koncert, poštujući zemljopisni okvir festivala. Nakon koncerta, pjevačica i dirigent su u foajeu dvorane do kasno u noć dijelili autograme i fotografirali se s obožavateljima koji su strpljivo čekali u beskonačnom redu. Ujedno, bila je to prigoda da ekskluzivno za Hrvatsku televiziju najave svoj skorašnji dolazak u Zagreb 10. veljače 2025., kada će nastupiti u programu "Best of Elina Garanča" u Koncertnoj dvorani Lisinski, čemu se oboje jako raduju jer su im prethodna dva koncerta u toj dvorani, na poziv njezina nekadašnjeg ravnatelja Dražena Siriščevića, ostala u lijepom sjećanju. O programu koncerta te općenito o Festivalu Eufonie govore mnogi njegovi sudionici koje smo susreli u auditoriju: Olga Wysocka, ravnateljica nacionanog Instituta Adam Mickiewicz, zaduženog za promociju poljske umjetnosti u inozemstvu; Kinga Wojciechowska, vlasnica i glavna urednica časopisa i portala posvećenog glazbi i umjetnosti Presto Publishing, medijsk...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) Instead of intrusiveness and technical dismay, in the music of one of the most versatile jazz -gitarist Bill Frisella there are calmness, beauty of tone and above all - music. She is so expressed with him that his music is not particularly interested in genre frames, and so is jazz in the narrow sense, the essence is simply put in the beauty of playing and it has an advantage over every kind of manner or restrictions. However, this does not mean that it is a root -free musician: with jazz, there are above all expressed earthen, folk elements of American traditions that pursue a large trough we can call American. Given this tendency, it is not surprising that Frisell is largely a musician of paint, space and sound scene. However, the same is unmistakably recognized in wider formats, from the breakthroughs in the bands of drummer and musical relative Paul Motian, with whom he will collaborate for four decades, to a variety of compositions in which Frisell continues to gather masters of unobtrusiveness, such as Joey Baron or Kenny Wollesen. If Frisell's "natural" habitat should be determined, these would probably be small compositions - duo, trio - where everything rests on the most welcome focus, listening and interaction. Triapal format is perhaps a solid frame of his bandlider action, starting with the baron on drums and Kermit Driscoll on the double bass, which would often be upgraded to other associates. In recent years, the key Frisell's music comrades of drummer Rudy Royston and the fantastic counter -bassist Thomas Morgan, with which he recorded a couple of exceptional duo albums. He also came to Rijeka with them, where he performed as part of the 33rd edition of the Jazztime Rijeka Festival, reminding us how much one can say when equal attention is left with the space between notes and musicians, as well as notes themselves ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Umjesto nametljivosti i tehničkog razmetanja, u glazbi jednog od najsvestranijih jazz-gitarista Billa Frisella tu su mirnoća, ljepota tona i prije svega - muzikalnost. Toliko je ona kod njega izražena da njegova glazba nije posebno zainteresirana za žanrovske okvire, pa tako ni jazz u užem smislu, bit je u jednostavno rečeno ljepoti sviranja i ona ima prednost pred svakom vrstom manire ili ograničenja. To međutim ne znači da je riječ o muzičaru bez korijena: uz jazz, tu su prije svega izraženi zemljani, narodni elementi američke tradicije koji se slijevaju u veliko korito koje možemo nazvati americanom. S obzirom na tu sklonost, ne čudi da je Frisell u velikoj mjeri glazbenik boje, prostora i zvučnog prizora. No isto se nepogrešivo prepoznaje i u širim formatima, od proboja u bendovima bubnjara i glazbenog srodnika Paula Motiana, s kojim će surađivati tijekom četiri desetljeća, pa do najrazličitijih sastava u kojima Frisell nastavlja okupljati majstore nenametljivosti, kao što su Joey Baron ili Kenny Wollesen. Ako bi se trebalo odrediti Frisellovo "prirodno" stanište, to bi vjerojatno bili mali sastavi - duo, trio - gdje sve počiva na najpažljivijem fokusu, slušanju i interakciji. Format trija je možda i čvrst okvir njegova bendliderskog djelovanja počevši s onim s Baronom na bubnjevima i Kermitom Driscollom na kontrabasu, koji bi se često i nadograđivao drugim suradnicima. Zadnjih su godina ključni Frisellovi muzički drugovi bubnjar Rudy Royston i fantastični kontrabasist Thomas Morgan, s kojim je snimio i par iznimnih duo albuma. S njima je došao i u Rijeku, gdje je nastupio u sklopu 33. izdanja festivala JazzTime Rijeka podsjetivši nas koliko se toga može reći kada se jednaka pažnja ostavlja prostoru između nota i muzičara, kao i notama samima...

programme.title: The art of architecture / Umijeće arhitekture
programme.desc: The Art of Architecture - (E07, Educational Program, England, 2019) The series represents some of the most famous architects in the world. We will find out how art affects the great builders of our time, from Santiago Calatrave to Sir David Adjae. We will get acquainted with a variety of projects, from the Batters power plant, through the Vanda Museum in Dundee, Distiliya in Speyside, the National Museum of African American History and Culture in Washington, the remodeled Museum of Design in London, to Vessel, which is not a house, but a magnificent staircase that will soon become a new symbol of Manhattan. R .: Alastair Layzell Ul.: Alastair Layzell (Narrator) ... / The Art of Architecture - (E07, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2019) Serija predstavlja neke od najslavnijih arhitekata na svijetu. Saznat ćemo kako umjetnost utječe na velike graditelje našeg doba, od Santiaga Calatrave do Sir Davida Adjayea. Upoznat ćemo se s raznolikim projektima, od elektrane Battersea, preko muzeja VandA u Dundeeju, distilerije u Speysideu, Nacionalnog muzeja afroameričke povijesti i kulture u Washingtonu, preuređenog Muzeja dizajna u Londonu, do Vessela, koji nije kuća, nego veličanstveno stubište koje će uskoro postati novi simbol Manhattana. R.: Alastair Layzell Ul.: Alastair Layzell (Narrator)...

programme.title: The painter of his country - Ivan Generalić / Slikar svoje zemlje - Ivan Generalić
programme.desc: The painter of his country - 100 years of Ivan Generalić - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2015) One of the most significant Croatian painters in the 20th century is undoubtedly Ivan Generalić (1914 - 1992). Moreover, this claim is shown to be accurate and in a wider context, namely, in the world fine arts, where his work also highly valued and emphasized criticism by authentic poetics and specific painting skills. In his life, Generalic was synonymous with Croatian naive art and had operated his small village of Hlebine in Pitomoj Podravina into an unavoidable address on the cultural map of Croatia. With this documentary film, his creativity is chronologically depicted and his originality and deep rooting in the traditional customs of the native village and the Podravina landscape emphasized. R .: Miljenko Bukovčan ... / Slikar svoje zemlje - 100 godina Ivana Generalića - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2015) Jedan od najznačajnijih hrvatskih slikara u 20. stoljeću nedvojbeno je Ivan Generalić (1914. - 1992.). Štoviše, ta se tvrdnja pokazuje točnom i u širem kontekstu, naime, i u svjetskoj likovnoj umjetnosti gdje je njegovo djelo također visoko vrednovala i apostrofirala kritika po autentičnoj poetici i specifičnom slikarskom umijeću. Još za svojega života Generalić je bio sinonim za hrvatsku naivnu umjetnost i svoje je maleno selo Hlebine u pitomoj Podravini prometnuo u nezaobilaznu adresu na kulturnoj karti Hrvatske. Ovim dokumentarnim filmom kronološki se prikazuje njegovo stvaralaštvo i naglašava njegova izvornost i duboka ukorijenjenost u tradicijske običaje rodnoga sela i podravski krajolik. R.: Miljenko Bukovčan...

programme.title: From the animator / Animatik
programme.desc: Animatics - (E255, Cult. Magazine, Croatia, 2025) 255. Animatics speaks of animated fairy tales and about Ivana Brlić Mažuranić, writers whose creativity became synonymous with the most popular Croatian fairy tale, but also gladly used inspiration for animated film. The guests are at the Studio of the Secretary of the Theater and Film Department in Matica, Vesna Muhoberac and director Ana Despot, whose last year's Forest Forest Striborova, will be created according to Ivana Brlić Mažuranić, see viewers of Animatika. The show also brings a review of the current cinemahit Snow White directed by Marc Webba, a feature transmission of a 1937 -based animated classic. The animation also shows two short animated fairy tales of the Zagreb Cartoon School of Zagreb. These are Abrakadabra from 1957 director Dusan Vukotic and Palcic from 1980, directed by Milan Blazekovic. R.: Gordana Bolcic ... / Animatik - (E255, kult. magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) 255. Animatik govori o animiranim bajkama te o Ivani Brlić Mažuranić, književnici čije je stvaralaštvo postalo sinonim za najpopularnije hrvatske bajke, ali i rado korišteno nadahnuće za animirani film. Gošće su u studiju tajnica Odjela za kazalište i film u Matici hrvatskoj Vesna Muhoberac i redateljica Ana Despot, čiji će prošlogodišnji film Šuma Striborova, nastao prema djelu Ivane Brlić Mažuranić, vidjeti gledatelji Animatika. Emisija donosi i osvrt na aktualni kinohit Snjeguljica u režiji Marca Webba, igrani prepravak dugometražnoga animiranog klasika iz 1937. u produkciji Walta Disneyja. Animatik prikazuje i dvije kratkometražne animirane bajke Zagrebačke škole crtanog filma. To su Abrakadabra iz 1957. redatelja Dušana Vukotića te Palčić iz 1980. u režiji Milana Blažekovića. R.: Gordana Bolčić...

programme.desc: Generation Y - (S01, Doc. programme.title: The world of classics / Svijet klasike
programme.desc: Classic World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) This is the first broadcast of four of them, which is being covered by the multi -day program of the sixth edition of the Euphonie Festival in Warsaw, the Festival of Central European and Eastern European Music, which took place this year under the theme "Jeke and Srection". It brings a review of a magnificent concert performance of a summer opera star, the world's largest mezzo -soprano Elina Garanče, with the Orchestra of the Great Theater of the Polish National Opera and under the leadership of her life and professional partner Karel Marko Chichon. The "Opera Gala" concert in November 15 was held and, among other things, performed the rarity aria of Carmen, which Bizet originally wrote for his heroine, but the singers declared it impossible for her and replaced her with a famous Habaner. Although she is talked about in an interview with Garanca, we could not record her for banning her publisher. That is why, with the interviews, we housed her first performance of Julia's lullaby from the 3rd act of Dvořák's Opera "Jakobinac" op. 84 from 1888, with which she opened a spectacular concert, respecting the geographical framework of the festival. After the concert, the singer and conductor shared autographs in the foyer of the halls late into the night and took pictures with fans who were patiently waiting in an endless order. At the same time, it was an occasion for exclusively for Croatian television to announce their recent arrival in Zagreb on February 10, 2025, when they would perform in the "Best of Elina Garanca" program at the Lisinski Concert Hall, which they both look forward to because the previous two concerts in that hall, at the invitation of its former director Drazen Siriščević. Many of his participants in the auditorium are discussed about the Euphonie Festival and the Euphonie Festival: Olga Wysock, Director of the National Institute Adam Mickiewicz, in charge of promoting Polish art abroad; King Wojciechowska, owner and editor -in -chief of magazine and portal dedicated to music and art, Presto Publish, Mediac ... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Ovo je prva emisija u nizu od četiri, koliko ih obrađuje višednevni program šestog izdanja Festivala Eufonie u Varšavi, festivala srednjoeuropske i istočnoeuropske glazbe, koji se ove godine odvio pod temom "Jeke i odzvanjanja". Donosi osvrt na veličanstven koncertni nastup letonske operne zvijezde, najveće svjetske mezzosopranistice Eline Garanče, uz Orkestar Velikog kazališta Poljske narodne opere i pod vodstvom njezina životnog i profesionalnog partnera Karela Marka Chichona. "Opera gala" koncert u održan je 15. studenog i na njemu su, među ostalim, izveli raritetnu ariju Carmen koju je Bizet izvorno napisao za svoju junakinju, ali su je pjevačice njegova doba proglasile neizvedivom pa ju je zamijenio poznatom habanerom. Premda se o njoj govori u intervjuu s Garančom, nismo je mogli snimiti zbog zabrane njezina izdavača. Zato smo uz intervjue smjestili njezinu prvu izvedbu Julijine uspavanke iz 3. čina Dvořákove opere "Jakobinac" op. 84. iz 1888., s kojim je otvorila spektakularni koncert, poštujući zemljopisni okvir festivala. Nakon koncerta, pjevačica i dirigent su u foajeu dvorane do kasno u noć dijelili autograme i fotografirali se s obožavateljima koji su strpljivo čekali u beskonačnom redu. Ujedno, bila je to prigoda da ekskluzivno za Hrvatsku televiziju najave svoj skorašnji dolazak u Zagreb 10. veljače 2025., kada će nastupiti u programu "Best of Elina Garanča" u Koncertnoj dvorani Lisinski, čemu se oboje jako raduju jer su im prethodna dva koncerta u toj dvorani, na poziv njezina nekadašnjeg ravnatelja Dražena Siriščevića, ostala u lijepom sjećanju. O programu koncerta te općenito o Festivalu Eufonie govore mnogi njegovi sudionici koje smo susreli u auditoriju: Olga Wysocka, ravnateljica nacionanog Instituta Adam Mickiewicz, zaduženog za promociju poljske umjetnosti u inozemstvu; Kinga Wojciechowska, vlasnica i glavna urednica časopisa i portala posvećenog glazbi i umjetnosti Presto Publishing, medijsk...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) Instead of intrusiveness and technical dismay, in the music of one of the most versatile jazz -gitarist Bill Frisella there are calmness, beauty of tone and above all - music. She is so expressed with him that his music is not particularly interested in genre frames, and so is jazz in the narrow sense, the essence is simply put in the beauty of playing and it has an advantage over every kind of manner or restrictions. However, this does not mean that it is a root -free musician: with jazz, there are above all expressed earthen, folk elements of American traditions that pursue a large trough we can call American. Given this tendency, it is not surprising that Frisell is largely a musician of paint, space and sound scene. However, the same is unmistakably recognized in wider formats, from the breakthroughs in the bands of drummer and musical relative Paul Motian, with whom he will collaborate for four decades, to a variety of compositions in which Frisell continues to gather masters of unobtrusiveness, such as Joey Baron or Kenny Wollesen. If Frisell's "natural" habitat should be determined, these would probably be small compositions - duo, trio - where everything rests on the most welcome focus, listening and interaction. Triapal format is perhaps a solid frame of his bandlider action, starting with the baron on drums and Kermit Driscoll on the double bass, which would often be upgraded to other associates. In recent years, the key Frisell's music comrades of drummer Rudy Royston and the fantastic counter -bassist Thomas Morgan, with which he recorded a couple of exceptional duo albums. He also came to Rijeka with them, where he performed as part of the 33rd edition of the Jazztime Rijeka Festival, reminding us how much one can say when equal attention is left with the space between notes and musicians, as well as notes themselves ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Umjesto nametljivosti i tehničkog razmetanja, u glazbi jednog od najsvestranijih jazz-gitarista Billa Frisella tu su mirnoća, ljepota tona i prije svega - muzikalnost. Toliko je ona kod njega izražena da njegova glazba nije posebno zainteresirana za žanrovske okvire, pa tako ni jazz u užem smislu, bit je u jednostavno rečeno ljepoti sviranja i ona ima prednost pred svakom vrstom manire ili ograničenja. To međutim ne znači da je riječ o muzičaru bez korijena: uz jazz, tu su prije svega izraženi zemljani, narodni elementi američke tradicije koji se slijevaju u veliko korito koje možemo nazvati americanom. S obzirom na tu sklonost, ne čudi da je Frisell u velikoj mjeri glazbenik boje, prostora i zvučnog prizora. No isto se nepogrešivo prepoznaje i u širim formatima, od proboja u bendovima bubnjara i glazbenog srodnika Paula Motiana, s kojim će surađivati tijekom četiri desetljeća, pa do najrazličitijih sastava u kojima Frisell nastavlja okupljati majstore nenametljivosti, kao što su Joey Baron ili Kenny Wollesen. Ako bi se trebalo odrediti Frisellovo "prirodno" stanište, to bi vjerojatno bili mali sastavi - duo, trio - gdje sve počiva na najpažljivijem fokusu, slušanju i interakciji. Format trija je možda i čvrst okvir njegova bendliderskog djelovanja počevši s onim s Baronom na bubnjevima i Kermitom Driscollom na kontrabasu, koji bi se često i nadograđivao drugim suradnicima. Zadnjih su godina ključni Frisellovi muzički drugovi bubnjar Rudy Royston i fantastični kontrabasist Thomas Morgan, s kojim je snimio i par iznimnih duo albuma. S njima je došao i u Rijeku, gdje je nastupio u sklopu 33. izdanja festivala JazzTime Rijeka podsjetivši nas koliko se toga može reći kada se jednaka pažnja ostavlja prostoru između nota i muzičara, kao i notama samima...

Bejart Balet jedno je od najznačajnijih svjetskih plesnih ansambala. Njeguje duh i opus velikog francuskog koreografa Mauricea Bejarta koje je Valentina Turcu tijekom niza godina plesanja u njegovu ansamblu upijala i sama. programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) Famous avant -garde musician Elliott Sharp tells of his music that he contains both decorated and rational, both intuitive and irrational. That double nature of Sharp's huge curiosity was visible from an early age. During the study of Sharp's, the curiosity of the branches in the fields of music composition, ethnomusicology and electrical engineering, and all these interests united in his professional music life. The interest in improvisation and avant -garde expression will mark his journey in the coming decades. In the late 1970s, she came to a soft musical research - New York, where he was established on the lush avant -garde scene there. Since then, one of her leaders will remain, an unstoppable researcher who is continuously moving to the science of science, philosophy and music, constantly enriching his musical work with incentives in fields such as physics and mathematics. Sharp will not stay in abstract spheres, separated from rough social and political everyday life. Consistently radical roots of his music will remain a loyal engagement on the side of the weaker and the oppressed. Throughout this movement forward, Sharp, however, does not neglect the past and tradition. Irrational and rational, avant -garde and tradition - Sharp's music - music is duality, who understands that he is poor without each other, as the second is without the first dead ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Glasoviti avangardni glazbenik Elliott Sharp za svoju glazbu kaže da sadržava i ono uređeno i racionalno, i ono intuitivno i iracionalno. Ta dvostruka narav Sharpove goleme znatiželje bila je vidljiva od rane mladosti. Tijekom studija Sharpova se radoznalost grana u područja glazbene kompozicije, etnomuzikologije i elektrotehnike, a svi ti interesi sjedinili su se u njegovu profesionalnom muzičkom životu. Zanimanje za improvizaciju i avangardnu ekspresiju, obilježit će njegov put u idućim desetljećima. Potkraj sedamdesetih dolazi u meku glazbenog istraživanja - New York, gdje se etablira na tamošnjoj bujajućoj avangardnoj sceni. Otad pa do danas ostat će jedan od njezinih predvodnika, nezaustavljivi istraživač koji se neprekidno kreće razmeđem znanosti, filozofije i glazbe, konstantno obogaćujući svoj muzički rad poticajima iz područja poput fizike i matematike. Sharp pritom neće ostati u apstraktnim sferama, odvojenima od grube društvene i političke svakodnevice. Dosljedno radikalnim korijenima svoje glazbe, u njoj će ostati vjeran angažmanu na strani slabijih i potlačenih. U cijelom tom kretanju naprijed, Sharp, međutim, nipošto ne zapostavlja prošlost i tradiciju. Iracionalno i racionalno, avangarda i tradicija - Sharpova glazba - glazba je dvojnosti, koja razumije da je jedno bez drugoga siromašno, kao što je drugo bez prvoga mrtvo...

Saznat ćemo kako umjetnost utječe na velike graditelje našeg doba, od Santiaga Calatrave do Sir Davida Adjayea. Upoznat ćemo se s raznolikim projektima, od elektrane Battersea, preko muzeja VandA u Dundeeju, distilerije u Speysideu, Nacionalnog muzeja afroameričke povijesti i kulture u Washingtonu, preuređenog Muzeja dizajna u Londonu, do Vessela, koji nije kuća, nego veličanstveno stubište koje će uskoro postati novi simbol Manhattana.
