programme.title: Films B.Tavnerier: Let the celebration began / Filmovi B.Tavneriera: Neka slavlje počne
programme.desc: Que La Feta Commence ... - (Drama, France, 1975) The historical drama of life in the court in the period before the French Revolution, better known as the age of regentism. The year is 1719, the French King Louis XIV. He died four years ago, and Filip Orlean (P. Noiret) is a regent for five -year -old Louis XV. He is a liberal and a liberal, he even managed to calm the peasant rebellions. For his assistant, he took Cardinal Guillaume Dubois (J. Rochefort), also a libertin ... R .: Bertrand Tavernier Ul.: Philippe Noire (Philippe Dorleans), Jean Rochefort (father Dubois), Jean-Pierre Marielle (Marquis de Pontcallec), Christine Pascal (Emilie), Adam (Le Marechal de Villeroi) ... / Que la fete commence ... - (drama, Francuska, 1975) Povijesna drama o životu na dvoru u razdoblju prije Francuske revolucije, poznatije kao doba regentstva. Godina je 1719., francuski kralj Luj XIV. umro je prije četiri godine, a Filip Orleanski (P. Noiret) regent je za petogodišnjeg Luja XV. On je liberal i libertinac, čak je uspio smiriti seljačke bune. Za svog pomoćnika uzeo je kardinala Guillaumea Duboisa (J. Rochefort), također libertinca... R.: Bertrand Tavernier Ul.: Philippe Noiret (Philippe dOrleans), Jean Rochefort (otac Dubois), Jean-Pierre Marielle (markiz de Pontcallec), Christine Pascal (Emilie), Alfred Adam (Le marechal de Villeroi)...

programme.title: Generation y / Generacija Y
programme.desc: Generation Y - (S01, Doc. Series, Croatia) The foundation of a healthy society says it is a family. But not every family is complete. In fact, what if it does not consist of all members who form a family? Through the prism of a mother who adopted a child, through a girl who grew up with her grandmother, through a family with many brothers and sisters in the episode "Children and Parents" from the Generation Y series, we will find out what it looks like to grow up some of the family members. What is parenting, which is most looking forward to raising children, how to manage in a single mother's situation ... Their common message is: everything rests on love! R .: Petar Oreskovic ... / Generacija Y - (S01, dok. serija, Hrvatska) Temelj zdravog društva kažu da je obitelj. Ali nije svaka obitelj cjelovita. Zapravo, što ako se ne sastoji od svih članova koji tvore obitelj? Kroz prizmu majke koja je usvojila dijete, kroz djevojku koja je odrasla uz baku, kroz obitelj s mnogo braće i sestara u epizodi "Djeca i roditelji" iz serije Generacije Y saznat ćemo kako izgleda odrastanje nekih od članova obitelji. Što je roditeljstvo, što najviše veseli u odgajanju djece, kako se snaći u situaciji samohrane majke... Njihova zajednička poruka je: sve počiva na ljubavi! R.: Petar Orešković...

programme.title: Garage / Garaža
programme.desc: Garage - (music. Show, Croatia, 2012) Luka Belani is a young, extremely talented singer -songwriter from Križevci with a Zagreb address. With his albums B-Side of My Mind (2009) and Changin Chapters (2011) he attracted attention to both criticism and audiences. The B-Side of My Mind called several eminent critics a debut-album of the year, and the radio single Guarded by Angels finished fifth in the annual list of the most performed domestic songs on one of Zagreb's listened to Zagreb's radio. Chargin Chapters achieved an even greater success that resulted in significant radio broadcasting, great media attention, excellent reviews in printed and internet media and performing at the 2011 INmusic Festival on the main stage. The album was listed in the Top5 home albums 2011 on the annual list of a well -known portal involving 32 music editors and journalists. The experience has more than 300 appearances, solo and with a band. In addition to performances in Croatia, this includes performances in London, Hungary, Serbia and three tour in Germany, of which in April 2012, she was a mini-European including Vienna and Amsterdam ... / Garaža - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2012) Luka Belani je mladi, izuzetno talentirani kantautor iz Križevaca sa zagrebačkom adresom. Svojim albumima B-Side Of My Mind (2009.) te Changin Chapters (2011.) privukao je pažnju i kritike i publike. B-Side Of My Mind nekoliko je eminentnih kritičara nazivalo debi-albumom godine, a radijski singl Guarded By Angels završio je na petom mjestu godišnje liste najizvođenijih domaćih pjesama na jednom od slušanijih zagrebačkih radija. Changin Chapters je postigao još veći uspjeh koji je rezultirao znatnijim radijskim emitiranjem, velikom medijskom pažnjom, odličnim recenzijama u tiskanim i internetskim medijima te nastupom na INmusic festivalu 2011. na glavnoj pozornici. Album je uvršten u Top5 domaćih albuma 2011. po godišnjoj listi jednoga poznatog portala u kojoj je sudjelovalo 32 glazbenih urednika i novinara. Iskustvom broji više od 300 nastupa, solo i s bendom. Uz nastupe u Hrvatskoj, to uključuje i nastupe u Londonu, Mađarskoj, Srbiji te tri turneje u Njemačkoj, od kojih je ona u travnju 2012. bila i mini-europska uključujući Beč i Amsterdam...

The HRT Symphony Orchestra, young soprano Josipa Bilic, cellist Branimir Pustic and the ensemble of the Ballet of the Croatian National Theater in Zagreb, united under the leadership of Maestro Martin Yates to perform some of the most beautiful arias and orchestral and ballet points from Pera F. Mendelssohn - Bartholdy, P. I. Prokofiev, I. Stravinsky, L. Delibeus, E. Griega, G. Faurea and J. Strauss Ml. The versatile British musician, conductor Martin Yates, appreciated equally in his homeland and abroad as a composer and arranger, takes us through a lavish opera and an orchestral-dance story-from a clear summer night over a fairytale thorny thorny to fire dance dance! Mendelssohna - Bartholdyja, P. I. Čajkovskog, S. Prokofjeva, I. Stravinskog, L. Delibesa, E. Griega, G. Faurea te J. Straussa ml. Svestrani britanski glazbenik, dirigent Martin Yates, cijenjen podjednako u svojoj domovini i inozemstvu kao skladatelj i aranžer, vodi nas kroz raskošnu opernu te orkestralno-plesnu priču - od vedrog Sna ljetne noći preko bajkovite Trnoružice sve do vatrenog plesa Žar-ptice! programme.title: The world of classics / Svijet klasike
programme.desc: The world of classics - (music. Show, Croatia, 2024) in mid -June 2024. During the six performances at his home theater Grande Palais du Beaulie, Switzerland Lausanne, her status of intriguing choreography, which in a harmonious compound of classics and modernity, comments and answers to the important questions of today. Bejart Ballet is one of the world's most significant dance ensembles. She nurtures the spirit and oeuvre of the great French choreographer Maurice Bejart, who has absorbed Valentina Turco during the series of dancing years in his ensemble alone. In honor of Beyart's version of Hamlet, 40 years ago, she now, to the Bejart Ballet, gave her personal reading of the Shakespearene drama about the Danish Kraljevic. Thanks to the footage that organized the theater, we enjoy the part of that successful project ... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Sredinom lipnja 2024. zagrebačka koreografkinja Valentina Turcu premijerno je uprizorila balet Hamlet s jednim od najvećih europskih baletnih ansambala, Bejart Balletom. Tijekom šest izvedbi u njegovu matičnome kazalištu Grande Palais du Beaulieu u švicarskoj Lausannei potvrđen je njezin status intrigantne koreografije koja u skladnom spoju klasike i suvremenosti daje komentare i odgovore na važna pitanja današnjice. Bejart Balet jedno je od najznačajnijih svjetskih plesnih ansambala. Njeguje duh i opus velikog francuskog koreografa Mauricea Bejarta koje je Valentina Turcu tijekom niza godina plesanja u njegovu ansamblu upijala i sama. U čast Bejartove inačice Hamleta otprije 40 godina sada je i ona, na narudžbu Bejart Baleta, dala svoje osobno čitanje shakespearijanske drame o danskom kraljeviću. Zahvaljujući snimci koje je organiziralo kazalište, i mi uživamo u dijelu tog uspješnog projekta...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) Famous avant -garde musician Elliott Sharp tells of his music that he contains both decorated and rational, both intuitive and irrational. That double nature of Sharp's huge curiosity was visible from an early age. During the study of Sharp's, the curiosity of the branches in the fields of music composition, ethnomusicology and electrical engineering, and all these interests united in his professional music life. The interest in improvisation and avant -garde expression will mark his journey in the coming decades. In the late 1970s, she came to a soft musical research - New York, where he was established on the lush avant -garde scene there. Since then, one of her leaders will remain, an unstoppable researcher who is continuously moving to the science of science, philosophy and music, constantly enriching his musical work with incentives in fields such as physics and mathematics. Sharp will not stay in abstract spheres, separated from rough social and political everyday life. Consistently radical roots of his music will remain a loyal engagement on the side of the weaker and the oppressed. Throughout this movement forward, Sharp, however, does not neglect the past and tradition. Irrational and rational, avant -garde and tradition - Sharp's music - music is duality, who understands that he is poor without each other, as the second is without the first dead ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Glasoviti avangardni glazbenik Elliott Sharp za svoju glazbu kaže da sadržava i ono uređeno i racionalno, i ono intuitivno i iracionalno. Ta dvostruka narav Sharpove goleme znatiželje bila je vidljiva od rane mladosti. Tijekom studija Sharpova se radoznalost grana u područja glazbene kompozicije, etnomuzikologije i elektrotehnike, a svi ti interesi sjedinili su se u njegovu profesionalnom muzičkom životu. Zanimanje za improvizaciju i avangardnu ekspresiju, obilježit će njegov put u idućim desetljećima. Potkraj sedamdesetih dolazi u meku glazbenog istraživanja - New York, gdje se etablira na tamošnjoj bujajućoj avangardnoj sceni. Otad pa do danas ostat će jedan od njezinih predvodnika, nezaustavljivi istraživač koji se neprekidno kreće razmeđem znanosti, filozofije i glazbe, konstantno obogaćujući svoj muzički rad poticajima iz područja poput fizike i matematike. Sharp pritom neće ostati u apstraktnim sferama, odvojenima od grube društvene i političke svakodnevice. Dosljedno radikalnim korijenima svoje glazbe, u njoj će ostati vjeran angažmanu na strani slabijih i potlačenih. U cijelom tom kretanju naprijed, Sharp, međutim, nipošto ne zapostavlja prošlost i tradiciju. Iracionalno i racionalno, avangarda i tradicija - Sharpova glazba - glazba je dvojnosti, koja razumije da je jedno bez drugoga siromašno, kao što je drugo bez prvoga mrtvo...

programme.title: Romano Bolkovic - 1 on 1 / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1
programme.desc: Romano Bolković - 1 to 1 - (Talk Show, Croatia, 2025) Prof. Dr. Miro Jakovljevic, physician psychiatrist, professor emeritus at the University of Zagreb, subspecialist of biological psychiatry and social psychiatry. We discuss with Professor Jakovljevic about the definition of the health and culture of the soul, the health of the well -being and satisfaction of our needs, the components of health, the salutogenesis, the construction of healthy society and empathy civilization, about toxic cultures and a sense of security, and paranoid culture, radicalization and manic, narcissistic culture in which we live and the transgenerational culture and the transgenequent culture and the transgenequent culture in which we live and the transgenequent culture and the transgenequent culture, in which we live and the transgenequent culture and the transgenequent culture, and the transgenequent culture and the transgenequent culture in which we live and the transgenequent culture and the transgenequent culture and the transgenequent culture in which we live and transgend Traumas, about depressed culture and a healthy individual in a toxic society, on the foam attacks on citizens around the world and in us, cult of happiness, false and authentic happiness, about the anomity of our society and the democratic right to be a fool, about Rifkin's concept of a race for global consciousness, what is the basis of Western civilizations. Prof. Dr. Miro Jakovljevic, Professor Emeritus, was the head of the Clinic for Psychiatry of the Faculty of Medicine, University of Zagreb at KBC Zagreb from 2007 to 2015, Head of the Department of Psychiatry of the Faculty of Medicine, University of Mostar from 2000 to 2013 and Vice -Dean of Science, Faculty of Medicine, University of Mostar from 2007. He has published 20 books, more than 28 chapters in the books of other authors and more than 200 scientific and professional papers. He was a leader and chief researcher in numerous national and international clinical research. The invited lecturer at numerous national, international and world congresses. The most mentioned is a psychiatrist in the region and is located on the Stanford list of 2% of distinguished world scientists in Croatia. He is the editor -in -chief of the magazine "Psychiatria Danubina" and the magazine "Medicine Academica Integrative". R .: Tvrtko Grgić ... / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1 - (talk show, Hrvatska, 2025) Prof. dr. Miro Jakovljević, liječnik psihijatar, professor emeritus na Sveučilištu u Zagrebu, subspecijalist biologijske psihijatrije i socijalne psihijatrije. S profesorom Jakovljevićem razgovaramo o definiciji zdravlja i kulturi duše, o zdravlju kao blagostanju i zadovoljavanju naših potreba, o komponentama zdravlja, o salutogenezi, o izgradnji zdravog društva i empatijske civilizacije, o toksičnim kulturama i osjećaju sigurnosti te paranoidnoj kulturi, o radikalizaciji i maničnoj, narcističkoj kulturi u kojoj živimo te o transgeneracijskim traumama, o depresivnoj kulturi i zdravom pojedincu u toksičnom društvu, o sumanutim napadima na građane diljem svijeta i u nas, kultu sreće, lažnoj i autentičnoj sreći, o anomičnosti našeg društva i demokratskom pravu da se bude budala, o Rifkinovom konceptu utrke za globalnom sviješću, o tome što je temelj zapadne civilizacije empatije te o sukobu civilizacija. Prof. dr. Miro Jakovljević, professor emeritus, bio je predstojnik Klinike za psihijatriju Medicinskog fakulteta Sveučilišta u Zagrebu u KBC Zagreb od 2007. do 2015., pročelnik Katedre za psihijatriju Medicinskog fakulteta Sveučilišta u Mostaru od 2000. do 2013. te prodekan za znanost Medicinskog fakulteta Sveučilišta u Mostaru od 2007. do 2013. godine. Objavio je 20 knjiga, više od 28 poglavlja u knjigama drugih autora te više od 200 znanstvenih i stručnih radova. Bio je voditelj i glavni istraživač u brojnim nacionalnim i internacionalnim kliničkim istraživanjima. Pozvani predavač na brojnim nacionalnim, internacionalnim i svjetskim kongresima. Najcitiraniji je psihijatar u regiji i nalazi se na Stanford listi 2% uglednih svjetskih znanstvenika u Hrvatskoj. Glavni je urednik časopisa "Psychiatria Danubina" i časopisa "Medicina Academica Integrativa". R.: Tvrtko Grgić...

programme.desc: The sprinters get a glimpse of hope on the 15th stage of Vuelta: 167.8 km from A Veiga to Monforte de Lemos. Første del er brutal med 3000 højdemeter, men finalen flader ud, og her har sprinterne en chance - hvis benene holder?

programme.title: Cykling: Return to Spain / Cykling: Vuelta a España
programme.desc: 4000 altitudes on a short, brutal stage make Saturday a key in the battle for the Vuelta. programme.desc: The film tells the story of Jack (Trumpy), a 5 -year -old boy sponsored by his loving and sincere mother (Larson) in a position that is far from the usual, as the two are trapped in a place whose area does not exceed a few meters, which Jack's mother always refers to in the name of (the room), the mother of (Jack) created a complete parallel universe inside the room, but the curiosity began to grow inside (Jack) They put them, make a risk -fraught plan to escape. / يحكي الفيلم قصة جاك (تريمبلاي)، صبي يبلغ من العمر 5 أعوام ترعاه والدته المحبة والمخلصة (لارسون) في وضع هو أبعد ما يكون عن المعتاد، حيث أن الاثنين محاصران في مكان لا يتعدى مساحته إلا أمتار قليلة، والذي تشير إليه والدة (جاك) دائما باسم (الغرفة)، خلقت والدة (جاك) له كونًا موازيًا كاملًا داخل الغرفة، ولكن بدأ الفضول ينمو بداخل (جاك) حول وضعهم، فتقوم بِسَنِّ خطة محفوفة بالمخاطر من أجل الفرار.

programme.title: Goosebumps / Goosebumps

programme.desc: A failed love story ends with the separation of a man and a woman and their departure from each other, but when they meet again after many years, this love story returns to open its doors again. / تنتهي قصة حب فاشلة بانفصال رجل وامرأة وابتعادهما عن بعضهما البعض، ولكن حينما يتقابلان من جديد بعد سنوات عديدة، تعود قصة الحب تلك لتفتح أبوابها من جديد.

programme.title: Beirut batch / دفعة بيروت
programme.desc: The events take place in the sixties of the last century, where a group of students travel to Beirut to study there at the university, and a number of exciting events are located. / تدور الأحداث في ستينيات القرن الماضي، حيث مجموعة من الطلاب يسافرون إلى بيروت ليدرسون هناك بالجامعة، وتقع لهم عدد من الأحداث المثيرة.في لبنان عام 1964، ويجد مجموعة منهم أنفسهم في دوامة من الأفكار والطموحات المتناقضة والعادات المختلفة... وفي شباك الحب.

programme.title: Raisinghani vs raisinghani / Raisinghani vs Raisinghani
programme.desc: In a dramatic framework, the skilled smart lawyer (Anushka) works with her ambitious colleague (Firat), but their lives change after the appearance of the trainee (Ankita) who hides her true intention and hides under the guise of the researcher for a job opportunity. / في إطار درامي، تعمل المحامية الذكية الماهرة (أنوشكا) مع زميلها الطموح (فيرات)، ولكن تتغير حياتهما بعد ظهور المتدربة (أنكيتا) التي تخفي نيتها الحقيقية وتتخفى تحت ستار الباحثة عن فرصة عمل.

programme.title: Abu Al Banat / أبو البنات
programme.desc: The father tries to deal with the challenges of daily life with his daughters and do a lot of love and sacrifice for them, but destiny reveals what his sister Marim did in the past, as one of his daughters changed the son of the wedding singer Laila for a goal in herself. / يحاول أب التعامل مع تحديات الحياة اليومية مع بناته وبذل الكثير من الحب والتضحية من أجلهن، ولكن القدر يكشف ما فعلته شقيقته مرايم بالماضي حيث بدلت إحدى بناته بابن مطربة الأفراح ليلى لغاية في نفسها.

programme.title: Life today / Hayat Bugun
programme.desc: The chief physician (Paris Jovinner) is appointed at Haysarono Hospital, in Istanbul, where the hospital is going through a difficult time, where (Paris) is trying to restart the hospital, and is fighting a difficult battle for his patients and colleagues. / يُعين كبير الأطباء (باريس جوفينر) في مستشفى (هيسارونو)، في إسطنبول، حيث تمر المستشفى بوقت عصيب، حيث يحاول (باريس) إعادة تشغيل المستشفى، ويخوض معركة صعبة من أجل مرضاه وزملائه.

programme.title: Golden Boy / Golden Boy
programme.desc: The events take place in a dramatic framework, where (Hallis Agha), one of the pillars of the established families in the city of (Gaziantep), decides to marry his riotous grandson (Farid), then the events continue. / تدور الأحداث في إطار درامي، حيث يقرر (هاليس آغا)، وهو أحد أعمدة العائلات الراسخة في مدينة (غازي عنتاب)، تزويج حفيده المشاغب (فريد)، ثم تتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: Testament betrayal / خيانة عهد
programme.desc: (Ahed) A wealthy lady, who owns a clothing factory, a large family, who plays reading the cup in which she was characterized by dangerous and critical turns in her personal and family life, and there is a conspiracy that is being woven from her closest relatives. / (عهد) سيدة ثرية، تمتلك مصنعًا للملابس، وهى كبيرة أسرتها، تلعب قراءة الفنجان التي تميزت فيها منذ الصغر منعطفات خطيرة وحرجة في حياتها الشخصية واﻷسرية، كما أن هناك مؤامرة تحاك لها من أقرب اﻷقربين لها.

programme.title: From the heart to the heart / من القلب للقلب
programme.desc: A social program, talking about topics related to charitable works and opening a door for viewers ’participation through social media. / برنامج اجتماعي، يتحدث عن موضوعات متعلقة بالأعمال الخيرية وفتح باب لمشاركة المشاهدين من خلال مواقع التواصل الاجتماعي.

programme.title: For a cat / لمعي القط
programme.desc: The series revolves around a bus driver (Mohamed Imam) in a private school, and while the driver returns the students to their homes after the end of the school day, one of the parents kidnaps the school bus and requests a great ransom. / تدور أحداث المسلسل حول سائق أتوبيس (محمد إمام) فى أحد المدارس الخاصة، وأثناء إعادة السائق التلاميذ لمنازلهم بعد إنتهاء اليوم الدراسي، يختطف أحد أولياء الأمور أتوبيس المدرسة ويطلب فدية كبيرة.

programme.title: Vanshaj / Vanshaj
programme.desc: The series revolves around (Juvena), the girl who differs with her family about the issue of inheriting the family's business for male members and demands inheritance for the most worthy. / تدور احداث المسلسل حول (يوفيكا) الفتاة التي تختلف مع عائلتها حول مسألة وراثة أعمال العائلة للأعضاء الذكور وتطالب بالوراثة للأجدر.

programme.title: Price / الثمن
programme.desc: The widow Sarah resorted to her only remaining option to cover the costs of treating her son Ibrahim from cancer, so he agreed to spend one night with the company manager Zain for an amount of money. / تلجأ الأرملة سارة لخيارها الوحيد المتبقي لتغطية تكاليف علاج ابنها إبراهيم من السرطان، فتوافق على قضاء ليلة واحدة مع مدير الشركة زين مقابل مبلغ من المال.

programme.title: Nile Palace / قصر النيل
programme.desc: The events revolve around the life of Camellia, whose father is killed after his fight with the aristocrat Fahmy Al -Suwaifi during her childhood, and Camellia returns after years to take revenge on the sons of Al -Suwaifi. / تدور الأحداث حول حياة كاميليا التي يُقتل والدها بعد شجاره مع الأرستقراطي فهمي السيوفي أثناء طفولتها، وتعود كاميليا بعد سنوات للانتقام من أبناء عائلة السيوفي.

programme.title: disappearance / اختفاء
programme.desc: The events revolve around a university doctor in Russia, and she lives with her husband there, but suddenly and without introductions her husband disappears, to start the journey of searching for him, and it comes to returning to Egypt as part of her research journey, but this trip surprises her with many things that she was not aware of. / تدور الأحداث حول دكتورة جامعية في روسيا، وتعيش مع زوجها هناك، لكن فجأة وبدون مقدمات يختفي زوجها، لتبدأ رحلة البحث عنه، ويصل بها الأمر للعودة إلى مصر في إطار رحلة بحثها، لكن هذه الرحلة تفاجئها بالكثير من الأمور التي لم تكن على علم بها.

programme.title: Your morning is Egyptian / صباحك مصري
programme.desc: A daily program, concerned with everything that happens in Egypt daily, by displaying all types of news, political, economic, as well as social, technical, and trying to highlight and present positive models in society, and hosting a group of decision makers in (Egypt) to discuss problems, community negatives, and how to solve them. / برنامج يومي، يهتم بكل ما يحدث في مصر يومياً، من خلال عرض جميع أنواع الأخبار سياسية، واقتصادية، وكذلك اجتماعية، وفنية، ومحاولة إبراز وعرض النماذج اﻹيجابية في المجتمع، واستضافة نخبة من صناع القرار في (مصر) لمناقشة المشكلات، وسلبيات المجتمع، وكيفية حلها.

programme.title: Days 2 / أيام 2

programme.desc: A daily program presented by the Egyptian broadcaster (Sharif Amer), which displays various readings, and an analysis of news in (Egypt) with an integrated team of experts in all different fields, the program presents the concerns of the Egyptian street, people's issues, political events, and others in a different way, and technology with a network of correspondents in all parts (Egypt), the program is shown daily from Saturday to Wednesday directly on MBC (Egypt). / برنامج يومي يقدمه المذيع المصري (شريف عامر) ، يعرض قراءات مختلفة ، وتحليلا للأخبار في (مصر) مع فريق متكامل من الخبراء في كل المجالات المختلفة ، يعرض البرنامج هموم الشارع المصري ، وقضايا الناس ، والأحداث السياسية ، وغيرها بصورة ، وتقنية مختلفة مع شبكة مراسلين في كل أنحاء (مصر) ، يُعرض البرنامج يوميا من السبت إلى الأربعاء مباشرة على MBC (مصر) .

programme.title: Esref Ruya / Esref Ruya
programme.desc: In a romantic framework, the rich and reckless businessman (Ashraf) is in love with (Revelation), who was looking for a person like his life, but what is ignorant of him is that she is working against him for the police. / في إطار رومانسي، يقع رجل الأعمال الثري والمتهور (أشرف) في حب (رؤيا) التي كان يبحث عن شخصية مثلها طوال حياته، لكن ما يجهله هو أنها تعمل ضده لدى الشرطة.

programme.title: Our club program / برنامج نادينا
My mom / أمي
programme.desc: Basma lives in a house that is shrouded in violence and neglect because of her mother's husband, Obaid, who suffers from a smile of ill -treatment and lack of safety, which makes her life full of fear and loneliness. Her teacher, Maryam, hinted silent signs of Basma's suffering, so she decided to intervene to save her from this difficult situation. Mary creates a strong relationship with Basma, and fights alongside her to free her from the circle of pain and violence, which makes a major shift in the child's life and gives her hope for a better future. / تعيش الطفلة بسمة في منزل يكتنفه العنف والإهمال بسبب زوج والدتها عبيد، تعاني بسمة من سوء المعاملة وقلة الأمان، مما يجعل حياتها مليئة بالخوف والوحدة. تلمح معلمتها مريم، علامات صامتة على معاناة بسمة، فتقرر التدخل لإنقاذها من هذا الوضع الصعب. تنشئ مريم علاقة قوية مع بسمة، وتكافح إلى جانبها لتحريرها من دائرة الألم والعنف، مما يحدث تحولًا كبيرًا في حياة الطفلة ويمنحها الأمل في مستقبل أفضل.

programme.title: Hakim Pasha / حكيم باشا
programme.desc: (Hakim) works to excavate the effects and their trade, then his uncle puts all the family’s property in his hand due to his intelligence and support for him in managing his business, and thus becomes great for the family and governs control of their affairs, but soon his enemies, and conspiracies surrounded by every direction, even from the closest relatives. / يعمل (حكيم) في التنقيب عن الآثار وتجارتها، ثم يضع عمه كل أملاك العائلة في يده نظرًا لذكائه ومساندته له في إدارة أعماله، ويصبح بذلك كبيرًا للعائلة ويُحكم السيطرة على أمورها، لكن سرعان ما يكثر أعداؤه، وتحيط به المؤامرات من كل اتجاه، حتى من أقرب الأقربين.

programme.title: Berlk's journey / سفر برلك
programme.desc: The work deals with the period of the issuance of the mandatory military service issued by the Ottoman Sultan at the time for all who are at the age of service and in the entire areas that fall under the control of the Ottomans at the time, through the story of four young men who gathered one idea towards independence. / يتناول العمل فترة صدور فرمان الخدمة العسكرية الإلزامية التي أصدرها السلطان العثماني آنذاك لكل من هم في عمر الخدمة وفي كامل المناطق التي تقع تحت سيطرة العثمانيين آنذاك، وذلك من خلال قصة أربعة شبان تجمعهم فكرة واحدة نحو الاستقلال.

programme.title: Under the seventh land / تحت سابع أرض
programme.desc: The officer (Moussa) takes advantage of his powers to achieve personal gains in corrupt and twisted ways, which makes him in a direct confrontation with the people who blackmail them, while discovering that his two brothers visit the dollars, and he finds himself in a difficult dilemma between leaving them to face the gangs alone, or managing this work himself to protect them. / يستغل الضابط (موسى) صلاحياته لتحقيق مكاسب شخصية بطرق فاسدة وملتوية، مما يجعله في مواجهة مباشرة مع الأشخاص الذين يبتزهم، بينما يكتشف أن أخويه يزوران الدولارات، فيجد نفسه في مأزق صعب بين تركهم لمواجهة العصابات بمفردهما، أو إدارة هذا العمل بنفسه لحمايتهما.

programme.title: Selma / سلمى
programme.desc: The series deals with the story of Salma, a young mother who faces life alone after her husband, Jalal, disappeared in mysterious circumstances. She finds herself obliged to raise her two children in poverty, shocks and loneliness, embodying her journey a deep humanitarian model of the suffering of Arab mothers who are steadfastly having life. / يتناول المسلسل قصة سلمى، وهي أم شابة تواجه الحياة بمفردها بعد اختفاء زوجها جلال في ظروف غامضة. تجد نفسها مضطرة لتربية طفليها وسط الفقر والصدمات والوحدة، فتجسد رحلتها نموذجًا إنسانيًا عميقًا لمعاناة الأمهات العربيات اللواتي يواجهن قسوة الحياة بثبات.

programme.title: Good morning, Arabs / صباح الخير يا عرب
programme.desc: A daily morning program, discussing the social problems of interest to the Arab citizen, which displays many paragraphs such as motherhood, health, beauty, art, travel, and community problems. / برنامج صباحي يومي، يقوم بمناقشة المشاكل الإجتماعية التي تهم المواطن العربي، يعرض الكثير من الفقرات كالأمومة، والصحة، والجمال، والفن، والسفر، ومشاكل المجتمع.

programme.title: The Office / The Office
programme.desc: The series revolves around (Hannah Howard), the managing director of a company, where she finds herself in trouble after knowing the news of closing her branch and converting it to work remotely, so she is trying hard to keep her team together. / تدور أحداث المسلسل حول (هانا هوارد) العضو المنتدب لأحد الشركات، حيث تجد نفسها في ورطة بعد معرفتها بخبر إغلاق الفرع الخاص بها وتحويله للعمل عن بعد، لذا تحاول جاهدة الحفاظ على فريق العمل الخاص بها معاً.

programme.title: MBC News / أخبار MBC
programme.desc: The newsletter of the MBC network, which works around the clock to cover all the news and events in various fields, with displaying its various details and developments from all angles. / نشرة الأخبار الخاصة بشبكة قنوات (MBC)، والتي تعمل على مدار الساعة لتغطية كافة الأخبار والأحداث في شتى المجالات، مع عرض تفاصيلها وتطوراتها المختلفة من كافة الزوايا.

programme.title: The sweetest of Tash / أحلى ما طاش
programme.desc: The program (Ahla Ma Tash) is returning a presentation of a group of the best episodes that were presented through the Saudi comedy series (Tash Ma Tash), which continued to be shown on Saudi TV for 18 continuous seasons, through which (Nasser Al -Qasabi) and (Abdullah Al -Sadhan) discussed a group of social issues that occupy the Saudi society in a sarcastic way. / يعيد برنامج (أحلى ما طاش) عرضا لمجموعة من أفضل الحلقات التي تم تقديمها من خلال المسلسل الكوميدي السعودي (طاش ما طاش)، والذي استمر عرضه على التليفزيون السعودي لمدة 18 موسمًا متواصلًا، والتي ناقش من خلالها (ناصر القصبي) و(عبدالله السدحان) مجموعة من القضايا الاجتماعية التي تشغل بال المجتمع السعودي بطريقة ساخرة.

programme.desc: The officer (Moussa) takes advantage of his powers to achieve personal gains in corrupt and twisted ways, which makes him in a direct confrontation with the people who blackmail them, while discovering that his two brothers visit the dollars, and he finds himself in a difficult dilemma between leaving them to face the gangs alone, or managing this work himself to protect them. / يستغل الضابط (موسى) صلاحياته لتحقيق مكاسب شخصية بطرق فاسدة وملتوية، مما يجعله في مواجهة مباشرة مع الأشخاص الذين يبتزهم، بينما يكتشف أن أخويه يزوران الدولارات، فيجد نفسه في مأزق صعب بين تركهم لمواجهة العصابات بمفردهما، أو إدارة هذا العمل بنفسه لحمايتهما.

programme.title: Hakim Pasha / حكيم باشا
programme.desc: (Hakim) works to excavate the effects and their trade, then his uncle puts all the family’s property in his hand due to his intelligence and support for him in managing his business, and thus becomes great for the family and governs control of their affairs, but soon his enemies, and conspiracies surrounded by every direction, even from the closest relatives. / يعمل (حكيم) في التنقيب عن الآثار وتجارتها، ثم يضع عمه كل أملاك العائلة في يده نظرًا لذكائه ومساندته له في إدارة أعماله، ويصبح بذلك كبيرًا للعائلة ويُحكم السيطرة على أمورها، لكن سرعان ما يكثر أعداؤه، وتحيط به المؤامرات من كل اتجاه، حتى من أقرب الأقربين.

programme.title: Canilo .Vs Croford Fight Week / كانيلو .Vs كروفورد فايت ويك
Our club program / برنامج نادينا
My mom / أمي
programme.desc: Basma lives in a house that is shrouded in violence and neglect because of her mother's husband, Obaid, who suffers from a smile of ill -treatment and lack of safety, which makes her life full of fear and loneliness. Her teacher, Maryam, hinted silent signs of Basma's suffering, so she decided to intervene to save her from this difficult situation. Mary creates a strong relationship with Basma, and fights alongside her to free her from the circle of pain and violence, which makes a major shift in the child's life and gives her hope for a better future. / تعيش الطفلة بسمة في منزل يكتنفه العنف والإهمال بسبب زوج والدتها عبيد، تعاني بسمة من سوء المعاملة وقلة الأمان، مما يجعل حياتها مليئة بالخوف والوحدة. تلمح معلمتها مريم، علامات صامتة على معاناة بسمة، فتقرر التدخل لإنقاذها من هذا الوضع الصعب. تنشئ مريم علاقة قوية مع بسمة، وتكافح إلى جانبها لتحريرها من دائرة الألم والعنف، مما يحدث تحولًا كبيرًا في حياة الطفلة ويمنحها الأمل في مستقبل أفضل.

programme.title: Berlk's journey / سفر برلك
programme.desc: The work deals with the period of the issuance of the mandatory military service issued by the Ottoman Sultan at the time for all who are at the age of service and in the entire areas that fall under the control of the Ottomans at the time, through the story of four young men who gathered one idea towards independence. / يتناول العمل فترة صدور فرمان الخدمة العسكرية الإلزامية التي أصدرها السلطان العثماني آنذاك لكل من هم في عمر الخدمة وفي كامل المناطق التي تقع تحت سيطرة العثمانيين آنذاك، وذلك من خلال قصة أربعة شبان تجمعهم فكرة واحدة نحو الاستقلال.

programme.title: Selma / سلمى
programme.desc: The series deals with the story of Salma, a young mother who faces life alone after her husband, Jalal, disappeared in mysterious circumstances. She finds herself obliged to raise her two children in poverty, shocks and loneliness, embodying her journey a deep humanitarian model of the suffering of Arab mothers who are steadfastly having life. / يتناول المسلسل قصة سلمى، وهي أم شابة تواجه الحياة بمفردها بعد اختفاء زوجها جلال في ظروف غامضة. تجد نفسها مضطرة لتربية طفليها وسط الفقر والصدمات والوحدة، فتجسد رحلتها نموذجًا إنسانيًا عميقًا لمعاناة الأمهات العربيات اللواتي يواجهن قسوة الحياة بثبات.

programme.title: Good morning, Arabs / صباح الخير يا عرب
programme.desc: A daily morning program, discussing the social problems of interest to the Arab citizen, which displays many paragraphs such as motherhood, health, beauty, art, travel, and community problems. / برنامج صباحي يومي، يقوم بمناقشة المشاكل الإجتماعية التي تهم المواطن العربي، يعرض الكثير من الفقرات كالأمومة، والصحة، والجمال، والفن، والسفر، ومشاكل المجتمع.

programme.title: My heart and key / قلبي ومفتاحه
programme.desc: A divorced woman seeks to return to her husband for her young son by finding a man who plays the role of the (analyst), then she meets by chance a driver in one of the private transport applications while he is not married, and he is marrying him to resolve her crisis, without revealing to him her true motivation to marry him. / تسعى امرأة مطلقة للعودة إلى زوجها من أجل ابنها الصغير عن طريق إيجاد رجل يقوم بدور الـ(مُحلل)، ثم تلتقي عن طريق الصدفة بسائق في إحدى تطبيقات النقل الخاص وهو غير متزوج، وتعرض عليه الزواج لحل أزمتها، دون أن تكشف له عن دافعها الحقيقي للزواج منه.

programme.title: Hidden camera program / ﺑﺮﻧﺎﻣﺞ الكامير الخفية
Hussein Ali Al Hawa / حسين على الهوا
programme.desc: The artist Hussein Al -Imam makes dumps on a large number of stars and celebrities during their hosting of their television program. / يقوم الفنان حسين الأمام بعمل مقالب على عدد كبير من النجوم والمشاهير خلال استضافتهم لهم في برنامجه التليفزيوني.

programme.title: Doctor's program / برنامج الدكتور
Sweet people / الناس الحلوة
programme.desc: (Sweet People) program is a specialized medical program. The program hosts doctors to find out medical information and to respond to consultations. / برنامج (الناس الحلوة) هو برنامج طبي متخصص، يستضيف البرنامج أطباء لمعرفة معلومات طبية وللرد على الاستشارات.

programme.title: Coercion / زواج بالإكراه
programme.desc: (Laila) A wealthy young man who is exposed to a traffic accident, which is bleeding and needs a quick blood transfusion, coincides with the blood type of her blood type with her private driver's blood, he transports blood to her without knowing that he himself is sick with AIDS and the disease moves to her, the young woman's life turns into misery and waiting for death, and she loves a new young man in her father's company named (Ahmed), but he does not exchange love; Because he loves (Hind), which he is about to marry, her father (Saeed Al -Koumi) threatens him to kill his fiancée and relatives in order to force him to marry his sick daughter with AIDS, and the events continue. / (ليلى) شابّة ثرية تتعرَّض لحادثة مرورية تنزف إثرها وتحتاج إلى نقل دم سريع، يتصادف أن تتطابق فصيلة دمها مع فصيلة دم سائقها الخاص، ينقل لها دمًا منه دون أن يعلم أنه هو نفسه مريض بالإيدز وينتقل إليها المرض، تنقلب حياة الشابة إلى تعاسة وانتظار للموت، وتحب شابًّا جديدًا في شركة أبيها اسمه (أحمد)، لكنه لا يبادلها الحب؛ لأنه يحب (هند) التي هو على وشك الزواج بها، يقوم والدها (سعيد الكومي) بتهديده بقتل خطيبته وأقاربه حتى يجبره على الزواج من ابنته المريضة بالإيدز، وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: The paths of faith / Cesty víry
programme.desc: Armenia is a state that was the first in the world to adopt Christianity as a state religion; It happened in 301. Despite the depth of tradition, the Armenian Apostolic Church in the Czech Republic is not a registered church. Still, Armenian believers live here. What does their life look like? What role does their faith play in it? And how is their lives tied to the environment of their home? Are they more at home here or in Armenia? All these questions are trying to find an answer a document, whose central character is the father of Barsegh Pilavchyan, Archimandrit Armenske Apostol Church for the Czech Republic, Slovakia and Hungary. The man who is old about the Armeske community in these countries himself contributes to the maintenance of traditions and beliefs in the communities of his compatriots and has long sought to register "his" church in the Czech Republic and the construction of its own church. / Armenie je státem, který jako první na světě přijal křesťanství za státní náboženství; stalo se to v roce 301. Navzdory hloubce tradice není Armenská apoštolská církev v Česke republice registrovanou církví. Armenští věřící tu přesto žijí. Jak jejich život vypadá? Jakou roli v něm hraje jejich víra? A jak je jejich život svázán s prostředím jejich současneho domova? Jsou doma víc tady, nebo v Armenii? Na všechny tyto otázky se snaží najít odpověď dokument, jehož ústřední postavou je Otec Barsegh Pilavchyan, archimandrit Armenske apoštolske církve pro Českou republiku, Slovensko a Maďarsko. Muž, který se o armenske komunity ve zmíněných zemích sám stará, v rámci svých možností přispívá k udržování tradic a víry v komunitách svých krajanů a dlouhodobě usiluje o registraci "sve" církve v Česke republice i o stavbu vlastního kostela.

programme.title: Three weeks of cell phone withdrawal: the experiment / Drei Wochen Handy-Entzug: Das Experiment
programme.desc: Headache, unrest, nervousness, aggression and phantom bells: the withdrawal symptoms among the young people are violent. The missing cell phone is to blame. 69 young people for Dok 1 An experiment and forego their mobile device for three weeks. Means: no social media, no news, no communication. Above all, the beginning is hard, because young people spend an average of about five hours a day with their cell phone and belong to a generation that often does not know what it is like to live without a smartphone. After four to five days, the young people discover the positive sides of the withdrawal. The extraordinary experiment is scientifically accompanied by the Anton-Proksch Institute and the Sigmund-Freud private university in Vienna. A DOK 1 that looks deep into the world of real and thought of the 16-year schoolchildren and shows how dependent we are all about our smartphones. Also the hip-hop superstar Raf, who grew up in Vienna ... / Kopfschmerzen, Unruhe, Nervositat, Aggressionen und Phantomklingeln: Die Entzugserscheinungen bei den Jugendlichen sind heftig. Schuld daran ist das fehlende Handy. 69 Jugendliche wagen fur Dok 1 ein Experiment und verzichten drei Wochen auf ihr Mobilgerat. HeiSSt: Keine sozialen Medien, keine Nachrichten, keine Kommunikation. Vor allem der Anfang ist hart, denn Jugendliche verbringen im Schnitt etwa funf Stunden pro Tag mit ihrem Handy und gehoren zu einer Generation, die oft nicht weiSS, wie es ist, ohne Smartphone zu leben. Nach vier bis funf Tagen entdecken die Jugendlichen die positiven Seiten des Entzugs. Das auSSergewohnliche Experiment wird wissenschaftlich vom Anton-Proksch-Institut und der Sigmund-Freud Privatuniversitat in Wien begleitet. Eine Dok 1, die tief in die Gefuhls- und Gedankenwelt von 16-jahrigen Schulerinnen und Schulern blickt und zeigt, wie abhangig wir alle mittlerweile von unseren Smartphones sind. Auch der in Wien aufgewachsene Hip-Hop Superstar RAF...

programme.title: We have to talk! The talk after the cell phone experiment / Wir mussen reden! Der Talk nach dem Handy-Experiment
programme.desc: Following the experiment, Lisa Gadstatters for a stimulating round of conversation in the ORF1 Talk Studio. Those responsible, experts and those affected discuss their immediate reactions, exchange their points of view and views and look ahead: How can we classify the results of the experiment for us as a society? How do we deal with what we saw there? What conclusions do we draw for our everyday life and where is there a need for politics? / Im Anschluss an das Experiment ladt Lisa Gadenstatter zu einer anregenden Gesprachsrunde in das ORF1 Talk-Studio. Verantwortliche, ExpertInnen und Betroffene diskutieren ihre unmittelbaren Reaktionen, tauschen ihre Standpunkte und Ansichten aus und schauen nach vorne: Wie konnen wir die Ergebnisse des Experiments fur uns als Gesellschaft einordnen? Wie gehen wir mit dem um, was wir da gesehen haben? Welche Schlussfolgerungen fur unseren Alltag ziehen wir und wo besteht Handlungsbedarf fur die Politik?

programme.title: Smartphone ban for Spain's children / Smartphone-Verbot fur Spaniens Kinder
programme.desc: A revolt from Spain: In Barcelona, ​​the movement "Teenager without a cell phone" is committed to simply banning smartphones before the age of 16. A demand with a large scope, because 80 percent of the 12-year Spanish children already have a smartphone. After "revenge porn" and scandal-fitting affares with minor year on social media, the goal is clear: no smartphones for young people under the age of 16. In September 2023, the movement was only supported by a dozen parents - today there are already 60,000. / Eine Revolte aus Spanien: In Barcelona setzt sich die Bewegung "Teenager ohne Handy" dafur ein, Smartphones vor dem Alter von 16 Jahren schlichtweg zu verbieten. Eine Forderung mit groSSer Tragweite, denn 80 Prozent der 12-jahrigen spanischen Kinder besitzen bereits ein Smartphone. Nach "Rache-Pornos" und skandaltrachtigen Affaren mit Minderjahrigen in den sozialen Medien ist das Ziel klar: Keine Smartphones fur Jugendliche unter 16 Jahren. Im September 2023 wurde die Bewegung nur von einem Dutzend Eltern unterstutzt - heute sind es bereits 60.000.

programme.title: concerns: us - reports without filters / betrifft: uns - Reportagen ohne Filter
programme.desc: E10 in the middle of Vienna is the Danube Island - a Green Oasis in the heart of the city. For many Viennese, she is a small paradise right in front of the home, especially for those who cannot afford a second home or vacation by the sea. In the summer months, streams into the local recreation area every day. Whether immigrants or long -established, young or old, sporty or sociable - everyone comes together on the Danube Island. Where does cohesion arise - and where friction? Adriana Juric went in search of answers and visited various communities on the island - all with their own ways of life and needs. Fur viele Wienerinnen und Wiener ist sie ein kleines Paradies direkt vor der Haustur, besonders fur jene, die sich weder einen Zweitwohnsitz am Land noch Urlaub am Meer leisten konnen. In den Sommermonaten stromen taglich Tausende ins Naherholungsgebiet. Ob Zugewanderte oder Alteingesessene, jung oder alt, sportlich oder gesellig - auf der Donauinsel kommen alle zusammen. Doch wo viele Menschen aufeinandertreffen, bleiben Konflikte nicht aus: Fragen rund um Platz, Mull und Larm sorgen regelmaSSig fur Spannungen. Wie viel Raum bietet die Donauinsel fur diese Vielfalt? Wo entsteht Zusammenhalt - und wo Reibung? Adriana Juric hat sich auf die Suche nach Antworten gemacht und verschiedene Communities auf der Insel besucht - alle mit ihren eigenen Lebensweisen und Bedurfnissen. programme.title: Three weeks of cell phone withdrawal: the experiment / Drei Wochen Handy-Entzug: Das Experiment
programme.desc: Headache, unrest, nervousness, aggression and phantom bells: the withdrawal symptoms among the young people are violent. The missing cell phone is to blame. 69 young people for Dok 1 An experiment and forego their mobile device for three weeks. Means: no social media, no news, no communication. Above all, the beginning is hard, because young people spend an average of about five hours a day with their cell phone and belong to a generation that often does not know what it is like to live without a smartphone. After four to five days, the young people discover the positive sides of the withdrawal. The extraordinary experiment is scientifically accompanied by the Anton-Proksch Institute and the Sigmund-Freud private university in Vienna. A DOK 1 that looks deep into the world of real and thought of the 16-year schoolchildren and shows how dependent we are all about our smartphones. Also the hip-hop superstar Raf, who grew up in Vienna ... / Kopfschmerzen, Unruhe, Nervositat, Aggressionen und Phantomklingeln: Die Entzugserscheinungen bei den Jugendlichen sind heftig. Schuld daran ist das fehlende Handy. 69 Jugendliche wagen fur Dok 1 ein Experiment und verzichten drei Wochen auf ihr Mobilgerat. HeiSSt: Keine sozialen Medien, keine Nachrichten, keine Kommunikation. Vor allem der Anfang ist hart, denn Jugendliche verbringen im Schnitt etwa funf Stunden pro Tag mit ihrem Handy und gehoren zu einer Generation, die oft nicht weiSS, wie es ist, ohne Smartphone zu leben. Nach vier bis funf Tagen entdecken die Jugendlichen die positiven Seiten des Entzugs. Das auSSergewohnliche Experiment wird wissenschaftlich vom Anton-Proksch-Institut und der Sigmund-Freud Privatuniversitat in Wien begleitet. Eine Dok 1, die tief in die Gefuhls- und Gedankenwelt von 16-jahrigen Schulerinnen und Schulern blickt und zeigt, wie abhangig wir alle mittlerweile von unseren Smartphones sind. Auch der in Wien aufgewachsene Hip-Hop Superstar RAF...

programme.title: We have to talk! The talk after the cell phone experiment / Wir mussen reden! Der Talk nach dem Handy-Experiment
programme.desc: Following the experiment, Lisa Gadstatters for a stimulating round of conversation in the ORF1 Talk Studio. Those responsible, experts and those affected discuss their immediate reactions, exchange their points of view and views and look ahead: How can we classify the results of the experiment for us as a society? How do we deal with what we saw there? What conclusions do we draw for our everyday life and where is there a need for politics? / Im Anschluss an das Experiment ladt Lisa Gadenstatter zu einer anregenden Gesprachsrunde in das ORF1 Talk-Studio. Verantwortliche, ExpertInnen und Betroffene diskutieren ihre unmittelbaren Reaktionen, tauschen ihre Standpunkte und Ansichten aus und schauen nach vorne: Wie konnen wir die Ergebnisse des Experiments fur uns als Gesellschaft einordnen? Wie gehen wir mit dem um, was wir da gesehen haben? Welche Schlussfolgerungen fur unseren Alltag ziehen wir und wo besteht Handlungsbedarf fur die Politik?

programme.title: Urban Pulse - the heartbeat of a city / Urban Pulse - Der Herzschlag einer Stadt
programme.desc: Since 1979, the Linz sound cloud has been beating as a pulsating heart of cultural innovation and artistic freedom. What started as an open-air event has developed into an urban spectacle that transforms the city of Linz into a living sound room and opened new perceptions. The 2025 edition, "Urban Pulse", immerses in the heartbeat of the city - in funfi -powerful pictures it sprints the rhythm of Linz: from industrial energy over river and nature to the Nibelungenbrucke, which becomes a symbol of the city a pulsating organism. Composer Johannes Berauer transforms this pulse into a powerful orchestral work that can bring the Bruckner Orchestra Linz to life. Percussionist Christoph Sietzen with his Motus Ensemble drains through a dynamic sound landscape, while director Simon Eichenberger visual spectacle made of fire, water, shadow figures and a container town on the Danube. Electronic music, live orchestra, sound installations ... / Seit 1979 schlagt die Linzer Klangwolke als pulsierendes Herz kultureller Innovation und kunstlerischer Freiheit. Was als Freiluft-Event begann, hat sich zu einem urbanen Spektakel entwickelt, das die Stadt Linz in einen lebendigen Klangraum verwandelt und neue Wahrnehmungen offnet. Die Ausgabe 2025, "URBAN PULSE", taucht ein in den Herzschlag der Stadt - in funf kraftvollen Bildern spurt sie den Rhythmus Linz nach: von industrieller Energie uber Fluss und Natur bis zur Nibelungenbrucke, die als Symbol der Stadt zum pulsierenden Organismus wird. Komponist Johannes Berauer verwandelt diesen Puls in ein kraftvolles Orchesterwerk, das das Bruckner Orchester Linz lebendig werden lasst. Percussionist Christoph Sietzen mit seinem MOTUS Ensemble fuhrt durch eine dynamische Klanglandschaft, wahrend Regisseur Simon Eichenberger visuelle Spektakel aus Feuer, Wasser, Schattenfiguren und einer Containerstadt auf der Donau inszeniert. Elektronische Musik, Live-Orchester, Klanginstallationen...

In einem Jahr tiefgreifender politischer Umbruche stand Herbert Kickl kurz davor, als erster FPÖ-Politiker das Amt des Bundeskanzlers zu ubernehmen. Doch nach dem Scheitern der Regierungsverhandlungen mit der ÖVP bleibt der Chef der mittlerweile starksten Parlamentspartei in Opposition. Wie geht Herbert Kickl personlich mit dieser Wendung um? Welchen Kurs schlagt er mit den Freiheitlichen ein und welche Machtoptionen stehen ihm nun offen? Lange hat er sich in den Medien rar gemacht, nun stellt sich Herbert Kickl dem ORF-Sommergesprach.

programme.title: The Pantanal - Brazil's mysterious water world / Das Pantanal - Brasiliens geheimnisvolle Wasserwelt
programme.desc: The largest inland moisture area is located in the sudwest of Brazil: the Pantanal. Almost half a year, thanks to the productive rainy season, thousands of square kilometers are under water. The change between floods and dry phases created a dense mosaic of lakes and small river walking, forest and grass landscapes over millions of years. Many, partly rare animal and plant species find a last refuge in the middle of habitats in the unique lowlands, which have been affected by deforestation, cattle breeding and agriculture. Here, Jaguars and Pumas are feasted on the lurk, while Capybaras and swamp deer feast in the aquatic sea. In between, rival Kaimane with giant more fountains rival the best fishmen. Fast ein halbes Jahr stehen hier dank der ergiebigen Regenzeit tausende Quadratkilometer Land unter Wasser. Der Wechsel zwischen Überschwemmungen und Trockenphasen schuf uber Jahrmillionen ein dichtes Mosaik aus Seen und kleinen Flusslaufen, Waldern und Graslandschaften. Viele, teils seltene Tier- und Pflanzenarten finden in der einzigartigen Tiefebene ein letztes Refugium inmitten von Lebensraumen, die durch Abholzung, Viehzucht und Ackerbau stark in Mitleidenschaft gezogen sind. Hier liegen Jaguare und Pumas auf der Lauer, wahrend Capybaras und Sumpfhirsche im Wasserpflanzenmeer schlemmen. Dazwischen rivalisieren Kaimane mit Riesenottern um die besten Fischgrunde. Himmelblaue Hyazinth-Aras, die groSSten Papageien der Welt, bevolkern lautstark die dichten Baumkronen, unter denen Gurteltiere tiefe Erdbauten graben und Ameisenbaren ihre lange Zunge auf Termitenjagd schicken. Bei modernen Neubauten findet man diese jedoch nur noch selten, dennoch kann man sich mit ganz einfachen Mitteln die jahrhundertealte Tradition der Vorratshaltung in der Erde zu Nutze machen: mit einer Erdmiete. programme.title: We, the youth of Iran / Wir, die Jugend des Iran
programme.desc: With the violent death of student Jina Mahsa Amini in police custody, three years ago, the greatest wave of protest in Iran since the state base in 1979. Nationwide, young people have been on the road nationwide, opposed the authority of the Mullah regime and demanded their freedom. The protests were bloodily depressed, but the change in Iranian youth continues unstoppably. Based on the stories of six young women, the world journal shows an extraordinary insight into the young, educated social class of Iran. 60% of the population is under 35 years. Their life is characterized by state repression and Willkur, of economic crisis and unemployment, but many are politicized, feminist, grun and networked. "It is the country that has to be eliminated, not me," says a young student - and thus speaks from the heart of many people in Iran. / Mit dem gewaltsamen Tod der Studentin Jina Mahsa Amini in Polizeigewahrsam begann vor drei Jahren die groSSte Protestwelle im Iran seit der Staatsgrundung 1979. Landesweit gingen junge Menschen auf die StraSSe, widersetzten sich der Autoritat des Mullah-Regimes und forderten ihre Freiheit ein. Die Proteste wurden blutig niedergeschlagen, doch die Wandlung der iranischen Jugend geht unaufhaltsam weiter. Das WELTjournal zeigt anhand der Geschichten von sechs jungen Frauen einen auSSergewohnlichen Einblick in die junge, gebildete Gesellschaftsschicht des Iran. 60% der Bevolkerung sind unter 35 Jahre. Ihr Leben ist gepragt von staatlicher Repression und Willkur, von Wirtschaftskrise und Arbeitslosigkeit, doch viele sind politisiert, feministisch, grun und vernetzt. "Es ist das Land, das sich verandern muss, nicht ich", sagt eine junge Studentin - und spricht damit vielen Menschen im Iran aus dem Herzen.

programme.title: Iran's water crisis - mismanagement, corruption and climate change / Irans Wasserkrise - Misswirtschaft, Korruption und Klimawandel
programme.desc: Heat, Durre and years of mismanagement have brought the Iranian capital Tehran to the edge of a water emergency. Electricity and water shutdowns make facts stand still and millions of people without tap water or air conditioning. Finally, a temporary closure of the capital or its long -term relocation was even discussed. In the World Journal +, the award-winning Canadian-Iranian documentary filmmaker Gelareh Darabi follows the path of the water crisis to start. Inefficient water management in agriculture, into which 90% of the drinking water flows, and wild growth on Staudammen and fountain have massively strengthened the consequences of climate change in recent decades. 80% of the reservoirs have dried up. The Zayandeh Rud, the once water-rich river of the central Iran, is also dry. Lake Urmia, once one of the largest salt lakes on earth, has shrunk to a tenth of its flat. The bizarre ... / Hitze, Durre und jahrelanges Missmanagement haben die iranische Hauptstadt Teheran an den Rand eines Wassernotstands gebracht. Strom- und Wasserabschaltungen lassen Fabriken stillstehen und Millionen Menschen ohne Leitungswasser oder Klimaanlage zuruck. Zuletzt wurde sogar eine zeitweilige SchlieSSung der Hauptstadt oder deren langfristige Verlegung diskutiert. Im WELTjournal + verfolgt die preisgekronte kanadisch-iranische Dokumentarfilmerin Gelareh Darabi den Weg der Wasserkrise zuruck an die Anfange. Ineffizientes Wassermanagement in der Landwirtschaft, in die 90% des Trinkwassers flieSSen, und ein Wildwuchs an Staudammen und Brunnen haben in den letzten Jahrzehnten die Folgen des Klimawandels massiv verstarkt. 80% der Stauseen sind ausgetrocknet. Der Zayandeh Rud, der einst wasserreichste Fluss des Zentral-Iran, ist den GroSSteil des Jahres ebenfalls trocken. Der Urmia-See, einst einer der groSSten Salzseen der Erde, ist auf ein Zehntel seiner Flache geschrumpft. Die bizarre...

programme.title: Seats / Herrensitze
programme.sub-title: Schloss Artstetten: Ein Heim fur den Thronfolger
programme.desc: E02 It was supposed to be the refuge of an emperor - and became the crypt of a prevented successor. ARTSTETEN Castle breathes the history of the double -headed eagle with every fugue. Franz Ferdinand was given this seat from his father in adolescence and expanded him over the years with a lot of money and dedication into a stately country seat. Karl Hohenlohe shows how it has lived here and also visits the muffle in the basement, where Franz Ferdinand and his wife Sophie were buried in Sarajevo after their murder. The Capuchin crypt was considered "no go area" that was hated by Franz Jospeh. / E02 Es hatte das Refugium eines Kaisers werden sollen - und wurde die Gruft eines verhinderten Thronfolgers. Schloss Artstetten atmet mit jeder Fuge die Geschichte des Doppeladlers. Franz Ferdinand bekam diesen Sitz in Jugendjahren von seinem Vater geschenkt und baute ihn uber die Jahre mit viel Geld und Hingabe zu einem stattlichen Landsitz aus. Karl Hohenlohe zeigt, wie es sich hier gelebt hat, und besucht auch jene denkwurdige Grablege im UntergeschoSS, wo Franz Ferdinand und seine Frau Sophie nach ihrer Ermordung in Sarajewo beigesetzt worden sind. Die Kapuzinergruft galt fur den bei Franz Jospeh verhassten Thronfolger als "No Go Area".

programme.title: Out of the frame / Aus dem Rahmen
programme.desc: E139 Karl Hohenlohe embarks on a journey through the history of the railway in Austria. At the end of the first steam railway line of the monarchy - in German -Wagram - he visits the railway museum there and gets an insight into the creation of the Emperor Ferdinands -Nordbahn. In the Heizhaus Strasshof he can heat a historic steam locomotive himself, pursue the sweaty work of the turnout, and reserved for the Esterreich's Federal Presidents in a wagon. R: Marcus Gotzmann / E139 Karl Hohenlohe begibt sich auf eine Reise durch die Geschichte der Eisenbahn in Österreich. Am Ende der ersten Dampfeisenbahnstrecke der Monarchie - in Deutsch-Wagram - besucht er das dort ansassige Eisenbahnmuseum und bekommt Einblicke in die Entstehung der Kaiser Ferdinands-Nordbahn. Im Heizhaus Strasshof darf er selbst eine historische Dampflok anheizen, der schweiSStreibenden Arbeit des Weichenstellens nachgehen, und in einem Waggon Platz nehmen der fruher den osterreichischen Bundesprasidenten vorbehalten war. R: Marcus Gotzmann

programme.title: Mountain world / Gebirgswelten
programme.sub-title: Hohenrausch und Leidenschaft in den Alpen
programme.desc: E01 Die Alpen: tourist magnet and cultural area with a breathtaking landscape. Around 100 million people attend the mountains and thaler of this mountain world annually. The documentation tries to answer the question of the magic of the Alps. Between Allgau and Zugspitze, Matterhorn and the North and Sudtirol mountains, people have their say who cannot imagine a life without their mountains. The region around the Dachstein Glacier in Austria is such a place for the mountain-credited and mountain-loving people. Hiking, climbing, extensive tours and daring descents with the mountain bike, a hollow in the glacier, a staircase over the slope. Year for year they created a new attraction there and lured into the region. Families in particular, like Manuela Richter, come with their children to experience the huge high alpine mountains. The documentation accompanies you to peaks and excursion experiences, but also shows how the region the mass-end tower ... / E01 Die Alpen: Touristenmagnet und Kulturraum mit atemberaubender Landschaft. Rund 100 Millionen Menschen besuchen jahrlich die Berge und Taler dieser Gebirgswelt. Die Dokumentation versucht die Frage nach der Magie der Alpen zu beantworten. Zwischen Allgau und Zugspitze, Matterhorn und den Nord- und Sudtiroler Bergen kommen Menschen zu Wort, die sich ein Leben ohne ihre Berge nicht vorstellen konnen. Die Region rund um den Dachsteingletscher in Österreich ist so ein Platz der Berg-Verruckten und Berg-Verliebten. Wandern, Klettern, ausgedehnte Touren und waghalsige Abfahrten mit dem Mountainbike, eine Hohle im Gletscher, eine Treppe uber den Abhang. Jahr fur Jahr haben sie dort neue Attraktion geschaffen und Gaste in die Region gelockt. Vor allem Familien kommen, so wie Manuela Richter mit ihren Kindern, um die gewaltige hochalpine Bergwelt zu erleben. Die Dokumentation begleitet sie zu Gipfeln und Ausflugerlebnissen, zeigt aber auch, wie die Region den Massen-Ansturm...

programme.title: Our Alps: Myths of the Alps / Unsere Alpen: Mythen der Alpen
programme.desc: In extreme landscape areas such as the high alps, the powers of nature and people meet the people particularly hard: Eternal ice and snow masses make mountain spaces unsavable for months. Thunderstorms, storms and hails destroy the harvests. Avalues, muries and lightning strikes not only destroy the livelihood of people in a fraction of a second, but also sometimes bring death to the Bergdorfer. Along the myth of eternal ice, the myth of the magical places and the myth of the holy water, the film develops its earnings structure. The camera sprints the place of mythical past and combines the most real stories that hide behind the legends and rites with the grandiose high alpine nature and cultural landscape of Austria, Italy, Germany, France and Switzerland. A film by Manfred Corrine Ko Orf/Arte/BMukk / In extremen Landschaftsraumen wie den Hochalpen treffen die Gewalten der Natur und die Bedurfnisse der Menschen besonders hart aufeinander: Ewiges Eis und Schneemassen machen Gebirgspasse monatelang unbegehbar. Gewitter, Sturm und Hagel vernichten die Ernten. Lawinen, Muren und Blitzschlag zerstoren im Bruchteil einer Sekunde nicht nur die Existenzgrundlage der Menschen, sondern bringen manchmal auch den Tod in die Bergdorfer. Entlang dem Mythos vom ewigen Eis, dem Mythos von den magischen Orten und dem Mythos vom heiligen Wasser entwickelt der Film seine Erzahlstruktur. Die Kamera spurt die Platze mythischer Vergangenheit auf und verbindet die meist realen Geschichten, die sich hinter den Sagen und Riten verbergen, mit der grandiosen hochalpinen Natur- und Kulturlandschaft Österreichs, Italiens, Deutschlands, Frankreichs und der Schweiz. Ein Film von Manfred Corrine Ko ORF/ARTE/BMUKK

programme.title: Pielach - in the garden of the Prealps / Pielach - Im Garten der Voralpen
programme.desc: The valley on the side of the Pielach has many surprising facets - you just have to know how to discover them. In the river itself, there are still considerable frames of the huchen, the legendary two meter long Danube coach, and many curious fish such as Stromer, Zingel and Goldsteinbeisser. On the banks of Bruten Gansesager, the rare kingfisher and 20 different types of dragonfly. Just as rare, even if civilization is a little close, the traditional craftsmanship, which are still being explored in the Pielach valley - are a blacksmith, broombinder or deer horn button maker. Sense for traditions lies in the essence of this front garden of the Alps: hardly where else is the traces of human colonization reach so deep into the past. Mammut hunter settled on the Pielach in the Paleolithic, Celts and Romer left their tracks. A journey with a chicken foot detail through the gentle sensations of the Alpine foreland. A film by Kurt Mundl / Das Tal zu Seiten der Pielach besitzt viele uberraschende Facetten - man muss sie nur zu entdecken wissen. Im Fluss selbst leben noch beachtliche Bestande des Huchen, des legendaren zwei Meter langen Donaulachses, und viele kuriose Fische wie Stromer, Zingel und GoldsteinbeiSSer. An den Ufern bruten Gansesager, daruber schwirren rare Eisvogel und 20 verschiedene Libellen-Arten. Ebenso selten, wenn auch der Zivilisation ein wenig naher, sind die traditionellen Handwerksberufe, die im Pielachtal noch ausgeubt werden - seien es Schmied, Besenbinder oder Hirschhornknopfmacher. Sinn fur Traditionen liegt im Wesen dieses Vorgartens der Alpen: Kaum sonst wo reichen die Spuren menschlicher Besiedelung so tief in die Vergangenheit. Bereits in der Altsteinzeit siedelten Mammutjager an der Pielach, spater hinterlieSSen Kelten und Romer ihre Spuren. Eine Reise mit Gespur furs Detail durch die sanften Sensationen des Alpenvorlands. Ein Film von Kurt Mundl

programme.title: In a traumort / Traumorte
programme.desc: E24 Norway extends to far north, far beyond the Arctic Circle. The land harbors many treasures in ice and snow that can best be discovered on a boat trip. From the historical city such as mountains and tromso to the natural wonders of the Lofoten, a winter visit in Norway will have many surprises. The high point of such a trip to the north is of course the fascinating aurora borealis. / E24 Norwegen erstreckt sich bis weit im Norden, weit jenseits des Polarkreises. Das Land birgt viele in Eis und Schnee gehullte Schatze, die sich am besten auf einer Bootsfahrt entdecken lassen. Von den historischen Stadten wie Bergen und Tromso bis hin zu den Naturwundern der Lofoten halt ein Winterbesuch in Norwegen viele Überraschungen bereit. Hohepunkt solch einer Reise in den Norden ist naturlich die faszinierende Aurora Borealis.

programme.title: The Faroer: Rough protective in the Atlantic / Die Faroer: Raue Schonheit im Atlantik
programme.desc: A rugged steep coat, shaped made of basalt and volcanic stone, the Faroineli protrudes from the sea and defy the stormy North Atlantic. Grass -covered mountain hitch, water trap and small brooks the landscape. A unique culture has developed here in the past 1,000 years. As a direct descendant of the Vikings, the Faringer is committed to their tradition without closing the presence of the modern world. Archaische Jager and Collector Culture meets modern art and music. Good life on the islands just 50,000 people live on the Faroers, which are an autonomous part of the kingdom of Danemark with its own government, without EU membership. The Faroers have extensive fishing rights that they use themselves or sell them to other nations. The yield of fishing has made the small island world rich. Billioners investments in the tunnel construction they afford to even the smallest of the 18 ... / Eine schroffe Steilkuste, geformt aus Basalt und Vulkangestein, so ragen die Faroerinseln aus dem Meer und trotzen dem sturmischen Nordatlantik. Grasbewachsene Berghange, Wasserfalle und kleine Bache pragen die Landschaft. In den letzten 1.000 Jahren hat sich hier eine einzigartige Kultur entwickelt. Als direkte Nachfahren der Wikinger fuhlen sich die Faringer ihrer Tradition verpflichtet, ohne sich dabei den Vorzugen der modernen Welt zu verschlieSSen. Archaische Jager- und Sammlerkultur trifft auf moderne Kunst und Musik. Gutes Leben auf den Inseln Gerade einmal 50.000 Menschen leben auf den Faroern, die ein autonomer Bestandteil des Konigreichs Danemark sind mit eigener Regierung, ohne EU-Mitgliedschaft. programme.title: Alm summer in West Styria / Almsommer in der Weststeiermark
programme.desc: When it gets summer, the western Styrian alpine pasture is very farm. Barbara Reicher has managed the rustic acid hute at 1,620 meters of Seehohe for 4 years. The day begins for the 45-year at 4:45 a.m., because right after the Frihstuck she starts looking for the almost 100 cows that she looks after all summer. In the meantime, Gerald Schlemmer has fulfilled a long -cherished dream after his retirement: he builds five meters long in Kainach near Voitsberg at Voitsberg. He receives support from his friend, the carpenter Gunter Anabith. The music should not be missing on the Styrian alpine pastures either. The folk music group "Hittrach" prefers to play in nature, such as at the Gasthaus Neuhausl at 1,200 meters of Seehohe, where they inspire the guest with their sounds.
